ConDenseDrive: Knowledge-Dense, Token-Sparse Visual Encoder for End-to-End Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

end-to-end driving visual encoder knowledge distillation token compression planning

简要说明：ConDenseDrive提出了一种用于端到端自动驾驶的三阶段视觉编码器，通过从视觉基础模型中蒸馏知识、将时空上下文整合到寄存器令牌中，并应用令牌压缩以提高效率，在NAVSIM和HUGSIM基准上实现了高规划性能和2倍加速。

TLDR: ConDenseDrive introduces a three-stage visual encoder for end-to-end autonomous driving that distills knowledge from vision foundation models, integrates spatiotemporal context into register tokens, and applies token compression for efficiency, achieving high planning performance and 2x speedup on NAVSIM and HUGSIM benchmarks.

Abstract: End-to-end driving requires rich spatiotemporal representations to support scene understanding and trajectory planning under strict latency constraints. However, most systems initialize their visual encoders from generic image pretraining and densely process all patch tokens for each camera view and input frame, limiting both representation quality and inference efficiency. To address these challenges, we present ConDenseDrive, a knowledge-dense and token-sparse visual encoder for end-to-end autonomous driving. Our three-stage framework first makes the encoder knowledge-dense by distilling complementary visual, semantic, and geometric knowledge from three vision foundation models. It then adapts the distilled encoder to multi-frame end-to-end driving and integrates spatiotemporal context into register tokens for planning. Finally, it makes the encoder token-sparse by applying register-guided token compression, reducing redundant patch computation and yielding a 2.0$\times$ speedup while improving planning performance. ConDenseDrive achieves 94.5 PDMS on NAVSIM v1 and 90.8 EPDMS on NAVSIM v2, and reaches 37.4 HD-Score in zero-shot evaluation on HUGSIM. Extensive experiments and qualitative analyses demonstrate that visual encoder design provides an effective route to reliable and efficient end-to-end driving.

摘要（中文）：端到端驾驶需要在严格的延迟约束下支持场景理解与轨迹规划，因此要求丰富的时空表示。然而，大多数系统从通用图像预训练初始化其视觉编码器，并对每个相机视角和输入帧的所有补丁令牌进行密集处理，这既限制了表示质量，也制约了推理效率。为解决这些问题，我们提出了ConDenseDrive——一种面向端到端自动驾驶的知识密集且令牌稀疏的视觉编码器。我们的三阶段框架首先通过从三个视觉基础模型中蒸馏互补的视觉、语义和几何知识，使编码器具备知识密集性；随后将蒸馏后的编码器适配到多帧端到端驾驶任务中，并将时空上下文整合进寄存器令牌以支持规划；最后，通过应用寄存器引导的令牌压缩使编码器实现令牌稀疏化，从而减少冗余补丁计算，在提升规划性能的同时带来2.0倍的速度提升。ConDenseDrive在NAVSIM v1上达到94.5 PDMS，在NAVSIM v2上达到90.8 EPDMS，并在HUGSIM的零样本评估中获得37.4 HD-Score。大量实验和定性分析表明，视觉编码器设计为实现可靠高效的端到端驾驶提供了一条有效路径。

Authors: Shengzhen Li, Yongkang Li, Hao Gao, Chenxi Wu, Yajing Sun, Lu Hou, Wenyu Liu, Xinggang Wang

Language2Drive: Do Vision-Language-Action Models Really Follow the Instructions in Autonomous Driving? AutonomousDriving

VLA models instruction following counterfactual benchmark CARLA simulation driving evaluation

简要说明：本文提出了Language2Drive基准，通过配对反事实单元评估自动驾驶VLA的指令跟随能力，发现当前VLA尽管驾驶能力较强，但经常忽略语言指令。

TLDR: This paper introduces Language2Drive, a benchmark for evaluating instruction following in autonomous driving VLAs using paired counterfactual units, revealing that current VLAs often ignore language instructions despite high driving competence.

Abstract: Recent Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models increasingly use natural-language instructions to condition autonomous driving behavior. Yet existing closed-loop benchmarks primarily measure route completion, safety, and rule compliance, leaving a fundamental question unresolved: does language actually determine which feasible behavior the vehicle executes? A trajectory may be safe and successful while still violating or even ignoring the passenger's instruction. To address this, we introduce \ltd, a benchmark designed to directly test this capability. Its key evaluation unit, the paired counterfactual unit (PCU), holds the initial driving scene fixed while changing only the instruction. This design enables us to distinguish isolated instruction success from counterfactual paired success across four instruction-following scopes. To test whether this distinction persists across evaluation regimes, we instantiate Language2Drive in complementary closed-loop CARLA simulation, reconstructed real-world scenes, and open-loop driving benchmarks, including our released CARLA-Language2Drive simulator with purpose-built maps. Evaluating representative driving VLAs across these settings reveals a striking mismatch between strong driving competence and weak language control: 93.2% of successful rollouts do not have a successful counterpart under the alternative feasible instruction. This failure is dominated by one-sided completion, where a model repeatedly executes one preferred behavior but fails when the same scene requires the counterfactual alternative. These results expose two fundamental limitations of current evaluation: isolated success and driving scores, which are widely used by conventional driving benchmarks, can substantially overstate language-following capability, while current driving VLAs themselves lack reliable instruction following under matched counterfactual tests.

摘要（中文）：近期，视觉-语言-动作（Vision-Language-Action, VLA）模型越来越多地利用自然语言指令来调控自动驾驶行为。然而，现有的闭环基准测试主要衡量路线完成度、安全性和规则遵守情况，却留下了一个根本性问题尚未解答：语言是否真正决定了车辆执行何种可行行为？一条轨迹或许安全且成功，却仍可能违反甚至无视乘客的指令。为填补这一空白，我们提出了\ltd——一个专门用于直接检验该能力的基准测试。其核心评估单元——配对反事实单元（PCU）——在保持初始驾驶场景不变的前提下，仅改变指令内容。这一设计使我们能够在四个指令遵循范围内，区分孤立指令成功与反事实配对成功。为验证这种区分在不同评估体系下是否依然成立，我们在互补的闭环CARLA仿真、重建的真实世界场景以及开环驾驶基准测试中实例化了Language2Drive，其中包括我们发布的、配备专用地图的CARLA-Language2Drive仿真器。在这些设定下评估具有代表性的驾驶VLA模型，揭示出强大的驾驶能力与薄弱的语言控制之间的显著错配：93.2%的成功轨迹在另一种可行指令下并无对应的成功反事实配对。这一失败主要由单侧完成主导，即模型反复执行某一种偏好行为，但当同一场景要求执行反事实的替代行为时则失败。这些结果暴露了当前评估的两大根本性局限：常规驾驶基准广泛使用的孤立成功率和驾驶评分，可能严重高估语言遵循能力；而现有驾驶VLA模型本身在匹配反事实测试下也缺乏可靠的指令遵循能力。

Authors: Zihan You, Zehua Fan, Wenqi Lyu, Aoqi Wang, Ni Wang, Yifei Yang, Linge Zhao, Huan Li, Sining Ang, Yuguang Yang, Jueyu Chen, Xiangyu Li, Qianshan Wei, Jieyuan Pei, Yuxin Wang, Zhiwen Chen, Jiaqi Li, Wenxuan Song, Yanyuan Qiao, Benjin Zhu, Haoang Li, Yan Wang

VLA-GAUGE: Systematically Evaluating Generalization and Robustness in Vision-Language-Action Models VLA

VLA robustness zero-shot generalization combinatorial perturbations diagnostic framework fine-tuning

简要说明：VLA-GAUGE 是一个系统评估视觉-语言-动作模型零样本泛化与鲁棒性的诊断框架，评测了12个VLA模型，发现其平均零样本得分仅为22.3%，并证明基于诊断的微调能显著提升特定能力。

TLDR: VLA-GAUGE is a diagnostic framework for systematically evaluating zero-shot generalization and robustness of Vision-Language-Action models, revealing low scores across 12 VLAs and demonstrating that diagnosis-driven fine-tuning can significantly improve targeted capabilities.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) have achieved high success rates on familiar manipulation tasks, yet it remains unclear whether such scores reflect genuine zero-shot generalization and perturbation robustness. Existing evaluation frameworks provide limited capability-level diagnosis and combinatorial perturbation coverage, often without connecting diagnosis to targeted model refinement. We introduce VLA-GAUGE, a diagnostic framework that unifies both evaluations under a shared executable task representation. It combines (1) paired in-distribution and out-of-distribution tasks across six capability suites, (2) single-factor sensitivity analysis with combinatorial perturbation screening and evaluation, and (3) diagnosis-driven refinement through targeted data augmentation and model fine-tuning. We evaluate 12 VLAs spanning different model sizes and action-modeling paradigms under a unified protocol. We find that (1) The mean Zero-Shot Score on VLA-GAUGE is only 22.3%, with SimpleVLA-RL scoring 8.0% and ranking second to last among the evaluated models. (2) Under three representative combinatorial perturbation configurations, the mean R-Score is 9.3. (3) Diagnosis-driven fine-tuning improves $π_{0.5}$'s zero-shot generalization and robustness under a selected perturbation combination on held-out scenarios by 72.4 and 31.8 scoring points, respectively; the latter exceeds the 10.9-point gain from LIBERO-Plus single-factor fine-tuning despite fewer successful training trajectories. These results show that high reported success rates on familiar manipulation tasks do not guarantee strong zero-shot generalization to unseen tasks or robustness to combinatorial perturbations, while diagnostic evaluation provides actionable signals for targeted model improvement.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）在熟悉操作任务上取得了较高的成功率，但这些得分是否真正反映零样本泛化能力和扰动鲁棒性，仍不明确。现有评估框架在能力层面诊断和组合扰动覆盖方面提供的支持有限，且往往未能将诊断与目标导向的模型优化相衔接。我们提出了VLA-GAUGE，一个在统一可执行任务表示下整合两类评估的诊断框架。该框架结合了：（1）六组能力套件中配对分布内与分布外任务，（2）单因素敏感性分析与组合扰动筛选及评估，（3）通过目标数据增强和模型微调实现诊断驱动的优化。我们在统一协议下评估了12个不同模型规模和动作建模范式的VLA模型。研究发现：（1）在VLA-GAUGE上的平均零样本得分仅为22.3%，其中SimpleVLA-RL得分为8.0%，在评估模型中排名倒数第二。（2）在三种代表性组合扰动配置下，平均R得分为9.3。（3）诊断驱动的微调使$π_{0.5}$在选定扰动组合下的零样本泛化能力和鲁棒性分别提升了72.4和31.8个得分点；后者超过了LIBERO-Plus单因素微调带来的10.9个得分点提升，尽管其成功训练轨迹数量更少。上述结果表明，在熟悉操作任务上报告的高成功率并不能保证模型对未见任务具备较强的零样本泛化能力，也不能保证对组合扰动具有鲁棒性，而诊断性评估能为模型定向改进提供可操作信号。

Authors: Jun Xiao, Rui Ye, Dong Cao, Jinyu Gu, Ying Wang, Zhiliang Zhu

Trust-Calibrated VLA Policy Post-Training with Evolving Imagination VLA

Vision-Language-Action Reinforcement Learning World Model Trust Calibration Robot Manipulation

简要说明：MERL 提出了一种用于 VLA 策略的信任校准强化学习后训练框架，通过在线演化的模拟器与基于可靠性的想象数据比例和 rollout 长度控制，在 LIBERO-PRO 和物理机器人任务上取得了更高的成功率。

TLDR: MERL introduces a trust-calibrated RL post-training framework for VLA policies, using an online-evolving simulator with reliability-based control of imagined data and rollout horizon, achieving improved success rates on LIBERO-PRO and physical robot tasks.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models are often pretrained via imitation learning, making reinforcement learning (RL) post-training important when deployment moves beyond demonstration coverage. Existing refinement paradigms expose a reliability--efficiency tension: model-free refinement avoids simulator bias but is interaction-intensive, whereas model-based refinement can exploit unreliable imagination even as its simulator adapts. We propose Model-Evolving Reinforcement Learning (MERL), a trust-calibrated framework that couples policy optimization with an online-updated simulator comprising a world model and a reward proxy head. Across stages, simulator reliability controls the imagined-data ratio and rollout horizon; within rollouts, chunk-level trust controls replay selection and optimization weight. For recursive imagination without exact grounded continuations, a residual predictor estimates trust without querying future ground truth. On perturbed LIBERO-PRO tasks, MERL reaches 79.7% average success, improves high-threshold learning speed by 10.9% over the matched model-free control, and outperforms same-protocol external baselines across three training seeds. Fixed-data adaptation from 50 demonstrations per task achieves 80.0% average success on two physical-robot tasks.

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-行动（VLA）模型通常通过模仿学习进行预训练，当部署场景超出示范覆盖范围时，强化学习（RL）后训练便显得至关重要。现有精炼范式在可靠性与效率之间存在张力：无模型精炼避免了模拟器偏差，但交互成本高；而基于模型的精炼即使模拟器在自适应更新，仍可能利用不可靠的想象数据。我们提出模型演化强化学习（MERL），一种信任校准框架，将策略优化与在线更新的模拟器（包含世界模型和奖励代理头）相结合。在训练阶段，模拟器可靠性控制想象数据比例和 rollout 长度；在 rollout 内部，块级信任控制重放选择与优化权重。对于缺乏精确接地延续的递归想象，残差预测器在不查询未来真实数据的情况下估计信任度。在扰动 LIBERO-PRO 任务上，MERL 达到 79.7% 的平均成功率，高阈值学习速度较匹配的无模型对照组提升 10.9%，并在三种训练种子下优于同协议外部基线。基于每任务 50 条示范的固定数据自适应，在两个物理机器人任务上实现了 80.0% 的平均成功率。

Authors: Wenzhan Li, Yiran Qin, Heng Zhou, Huirui Wang, Yulan Guo, Ruimao Zhang

Listen Before Act: Audio-Conditioned Robot Manipulation with ListenVLA VLA

Audio-conditioned VLA Robot manipulation GR00T N1.7 Multimodal policy Action binding

简要说明：ListenVLA 将 GR00T N1.7 VLA 模型扩展为支持音频条件和音频-动作绑定目标，从而在新型 LIBERO-Audio 基准和真实世界任务中实现声音引导的机器人操作。

TLDR: ListenVLA extends the GR00T N1.7 VLA model with audio conditioning and a novel audio-action binding objective, enabling sound-guided robot manipulation on a new LIBERO-Audio benchmark and real-world tasks.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models have advanced robotic manipulation by connecting visual perception and language instructions to action generation. However, many manipulation tasks depend on auditory cues that cannot be reliably inferred from visual observations and may need to be elicited through physical interaction. To address this gap, we present ListenVLA, an audio-conditioned VLA policy built on GR00T N1.7 for sound-guided manipulation. ListenVLA combines semantic audio embeddings with waveform-derived acoustic cues over a causal audio history and conditions continuous action generation through audio tokens and feature modulation. Moreover, we introduce an audio-action binding objective that uses context-matched demonstrations to link auditory differences to demonstrated action differences. The objective supervises short-horizon differences between flow-velocity predictions under different audio conditions, with shared pure-noise action inputs and fixed non-audio observations, alongside full-chunk action supervision. Furthermore, we develop LIBERO-Audio, an eight-task benchmark covering sound-based target selection, responses to auditory events, and physical interactions that reveal acoustic evidence. Experiments on LIBERO-Audio and three real-world manipulation tasks show excellent performance. Ablation studies support the contributions of binding supervision and audio modulation, while audio swap tests show that sound influences action predictions. Our code and videos are available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/listenvla-F18D

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过将视觉感知和语言指令与动作生成相连接，推动了机器人操作任务的进展。然而，许多操作任务依赖于无法仅从视觉观察中可靠推断的听觉线索，且这些线索往往需要通过物理交互来引发。为解决这一不足，我们提出了ListenVLA，一种基于GR00T N1.7构建的音频条件VLA策略，用于声音引导的操作任务。ListenVLA将语义音频嵌入与基于波形的声学线索相结合，利用因果音频历史信息，并通过音频令牌和特征调制来条件化连续动作生成。此外，我们引入了一种音频-动作绑定目标，利用上下文匹配的示范将听觉差异与示范动作差异相关联。该目标在不同音频条件下、共享纯噪声动作输入和固定非音频观测的情况下，对流速预测之间的短时程差异进行监督，同时辅以完整动作块监督。进一步地，我们开发了LIBERO-Audio基准，包含八个任务，涵盖基于声音的目标选择、对听觉事件的响应，以及可揭示声学证据的物理交互。在LIBERO-Audio和三项真实世界操作任务上的实验展示了优异的性能。消融研究验证了绑定监督和音频调制的贡献，而音频交换测试表明声音会影响动作预测。我们的代码和视频可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/listenvla-F18D 获取。

Authors: Jiaqi Fan, Rui Xu, Jiakun Xia, Xuyu Fan, Shuailei Ma, Yuefeng Wang, Qing Wang, Jiarui Zhang, Yili Fu, Xu Li

FlowVLA: Enabling World Dynamics Understanding through Pluggable 3D Flow Learning VLA

Vision-Language-Action models 3D flow learning dual-level flow supervision robot manipulation reconstruction-guided

简要说明：FlowVLA 提出了一种可插拔的 3D 流学习框架，在训练期间使用双层级（点级和 TCP 级）流监督来增强 VLA 模型对 3D 动态的理解，从而提升操作鲁棒性和数据效率，且不增加推理时的计算负担。

TLDR: FlowVLA introduces a pluggable 3D flow learning framework that uses dual-level (point and TCP) flow supervision during training to enhance VLA models' understanding of 3D dynamics, improving manipulation robustness and data efficiency without adding inference-time overhead.

Abstract: Recent advances in 3D reconstruction enable the extraction of temporally consistent 3D motion from RGB observations; however, current Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models still predominantly rely on 2D image-text priors. Therefore, they do not accurately represent the fundamental dynamics of the 3D world associated with physical actions. This over-reliance on static 2D visual cues limits the capacity of VLA models in achieving robust robot manipulation. To address these limitations, we introduce FlowVLA, a reconstruction-guided, pluggable 3D flow learning framework aimed at empowering VLA models with an inherent understanding of action-relevant dynamics. Instead of requiring explicit 3D sensor inputs or altering the inference-time architecture, our method is designed to utilize temporally aligned 3D flow only during training. This allows the model to learn the dynamic evolution of the physical scene while preserving the computational efficiency of conventional 2D VLA backbones. To bridge scene-level dynamics with robotic manipulation, we propose a modular 3D flow learning framework with dual-level flow supervision. Specifically, point-level flow guides the model to forecast the future displacements of task-critical 3D points, while TCP-level flow aggregates these motions to align with the robot's TCP trajectories. This dual-level flow supervision encourages the model to focus on semantically meaningful dynamic regions, effectively coupling scene-level motion with precise control signals. Extensive evaluations across simulation and real-world experiments demonstrate that FlowVLA consistently improves manipulation performance, zero-shot robustness, and optimizes data efficiency. FlowVLA adds only lightweight auxiliary heads during training and discards them at inference. Therefore, FlowVLA introduces no additional 3D sensor inputs, architectural modifications, or inference-time computation.

摘要（中文）：近期在三维重建领域的进展使得从RGB观测中提取时间上一致的三维运动成为可能；然而，当前的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型仍主要依赖二维图像-文本先验。因此，它们无法准确表征与物理动作相关联的三维世界的基本动力学特性。这种对静态二维视觉线索的过度依赖限制了VLA模型在实现稳健机器人操作方面的能力。为应对这些局限性，我们提出了FlowVLA——一种重建引导的、可插拔的三维流学习框架，旨在赋予VLA模型对动作相关动力学的内在理解能力。我们的方法无需显式的三维传感器输入，也无需改变推理时的架构，而是仅在训练阶段利用时间对齐的三维流。这使得模型能够学习物理场景的动态演化过程，同时保持传统二维VLA骨干网络的计算效率。为将场景级动力学与机器人操作相衔接，我们提出了一种具有双层流监督的模块化三维流学习框架。具体而言，点级流引导模型预测任务关键三维点的未来位移，而TCP级流则聚合这些运动以与机器人的TCP轨迹对齐。这种双层流监督机制促使模型关注具有语义意义的动态区域，有效实现了场景级运动与精确控制信号的耦合。跨仿真和真实世界实验的广泛评估表明，FlowVLA持续提升了操作性能、零样本鲁棒性，并优化了数据效率。FlowVLA仅在训练阶段增加轻量级辅助头，推理时则将其丢弃。因此，FlowVLA不引入额外的三维传感器输入、架构修改或推理时计算开销。

Authors: Junhyeong Go, Mingyu Jung, Woobin Im, Jongbin Ryu

AUGUstus: Autonomous Driving VLA Model with Unified Generation and Understanding VLA

VLA diffusion action generation chain-of-thought end-to-end driving low-latency planning

简要说明：AUGUstus提出了一种自动驾驶VLA模型，统一了基于扩散的动作生成和自回归思维链理解，实现了低延迟、可解释的规划，在NAVSIM和nuScenes上取得了最先进的结果，并可在实车上以12 Hz频率部署。

TLDR: AUGUstus presents an autonomous driving VLA model that unifies diffusion-based action generation with autoregressive chain-of-thought understanding, enabling low-latency, explainable planning that achieves state-of-the-art results on NAVSIM and nuScenes and is deployable on a real vehicle at 12 Hz.

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging world knowledge and understanding to excel in long-tail scenarios. However, current VLAs have two limitations: 1) Degeneration into vision-action (VA) models. For low latency, regression/flow-based methods directly generate actions but underuse VLM understanding, causing unsafe, unexplainable actions. 2) Autoregressive high latency. Autoregressive methods sequentially generate chain-of-thought (CoT) and action tokens, fully leveraging VLM understanding, but high latency hinders deployment. To enable low-latency deployment while using CoT to assist action generation, we propose AUGUstus, an Autonomous-driving VLA model with Unified Generation and Understanding. We unify diffusion-based action generation and autoregressive CoT understanding in one model, where understanding only serves generation. Joint CoT supervision preserves VLM spatial understanding in shared representation for safer, more accurate trajectories. AUGUstus-mode orders action generation before CoT, so CoT supervises reliable actions during training while inference needs only action output, enabling low latency. AUGUstus-GRPO, a unified GRPO algorithm, jointly optimizes action and CoT, improving action performance. Experiments show AUGUstus achieves 94.6 PDMS on NAVSIMv1 and 90.7 EPDMS on NAVSIMv2, SOTA planning without scorer module. On nuScenes, it achieves average L2 error 0.27 m and average collision rate 0.05%, best among compared methods. To validate AUGUstus practicality, we train on in-house data with 512 NVIDIA H800 GPUs for ~2 days, evaluate on an internal 1,000 km dataset, and preliminarily deploy on a real vehicle, achieving 12 Hz operation. Project page: https://augustus-ad.github.io

摘要（中文）：视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型凭借其世界知识和理解能力，在端到端自动驾驶的长尾场景中展现出巨大潜力。然而，现有VLA模型存在两个局限：1）退化为视觉-动作（VA）模型。为降低延迟，基于回归/流的方法直接生成动作，但未能充分利用VLM的理解能力，导致动作不安全且缺乏可解释性。2）自回归高延迟。自回归方法顺序生成思维链（CoT）和动作令牌，充分发挥了VLM的理解能力，但高延迟阻碍了部署。为了实现低延迟部署，同时利用CoT辅助动作生成，我们提出了AUGUstus——一种统一生成与理解的自动驾驶VLA模型。我们在单一模型中统一了基于扩散的动作生成和自回归CoT理解，其中理解仅服务于生成。联合CoT监督在共享表示中保留VLM的空间理解能力，从而生成更安全、更准确的轨迹。AUGUstus模式将动作生成置于CoT之前，因此在训练期间CoT监督可靠的动作，而推理时仅需动作输出，从而实现低延迟。AUGUstus-GRPO是一种统一的GRPO算法，联合优化动作和CoT，提升了动作性能。实验表明，AUGUstus在NAVSIMv1上达到94.6 PDMS，在NAVSIMv2上达到90.7 EPDMS，在没有评分器模块的情况下实现了SOTA规划性能。在nuScenes上，其平均L2误差为0.27米，平均碰撞率为0.05%，在对比方法中表现最优。为验证AUGUstus的实用性，我们在512块NVIDIA H800 GPU上使用内部数据训练约2天，在内部1,000公里数据集上评估，并在实车上初步部署，实现了12 Hz运行。项目主页：https://augustus-ad.github.io

Authors: Yuqi Ye, Caigao Jiang, Zhuonan Wang, Congyuan Pei, Chao Qu, Changhao Peng, Junhong Lin, Qize Yu, Zetian Song, Guangzhao Fu, Chongruo Wu, Shiyu Huang, Shuchang Zhou, Honggou Yang, Wei Gao

DexNinja: Learning Robust Dexterous Cutting Policy with a Real-to-Sim-to-Real Data Engine Manipulation

dexterous manipulation real-to-sim-to-real differentiable simulator sim-to-real transfer food cutting

简要说明：DexNinja 提出了一种真实到仿真再到真实的数据引擎，用于学习鲁棒的灵巧食物切割策略，通过对象重建、物理参数随机化和可微仿真生成增强训练数据，仅需少量真实示范即可提高成功率并泛化到分布外对象。

TLDR: DexNinja introduces a real-to-sim-to-real data engine for learning robust dexterous food-cutting policies, combining object reconstruction, physically meaningful parameter randomization, and a differentiable simulator to generate augmented training data from a few real demonstrations, achieving improved success rates and generalization to out-of-distribution objects.

Abstract: Cutting a piece of food looks effortless in human hands. For a robot, however, every cut is a high-contact interaction with a deformable, elasto-plastic object whose behavior changes with pose, contact mode, and cutting stage. Collecting real-world data is expensive and wasteful: each trial typically contaminates or damages the food, so obtaining scalable real world data for dexterous cutting is expensive and difficult. Simulation is an appealing alternative, but a large sim-to-real gap exists in both physics and perception. This gap is especially severe for topology-changing interactions like cutting, where small errors in contact, friction, or material and elasticity responses quickly compound. We propose \textsc{DexNinja}, a real2sim2real framework that turns a handful of real demonstrations into a dense and realistic training distribution. \textsc{DexNinja} (i) reconstructs object instances from real captures, (ii) randomizes physically meaningful parameters under category-level constraints, and (iii) produces augmented dexterous manipulation episodes using a custom differentiable simulator that couples robot dynamics, tactile contact, and deformable cutting. We evaluate \textsc{DexNinja} on a dexterous food-slicing task and show that (1) with tens of real demonstrations and hundreds of augmented simulator data, the success rate could reach more than 60\%. (2) the augmented data consistently improves success rates when only using real data with more than 20\% via sim-to-real, and (3) the resulting policies generalize to out-of-distribution objects with varying shapes and sizes.

摘要（中文）：切割一块食物在人类手中看起来毫不费力。然而，对于机器人而言，每一次切割都是与可变形、弹塑性物体的一次高接触互动，该物体的行为会随姿态、接触模式及切割阶段而变化。采集真实世界数据既昂贵又浪费：每次试验通常都会污染或损坏食物，因此为灵巧切割获取可扩展的真实世界数据成本高昂且难度极大。仿真是一种颇具吸引力的替代方案，但在物理和感知方面均存在较大的仿真到现实差距。这一差距在诸如切割这类涉及拓扑变化的交互中尤为严重，因为接触、摩擦或材料及弹性响应中的微小误差会迅速累积放大。我们提出\textsc{DexNinja}，一个“真实到仿真再到真实”（real2sim2real）框架，可将少量真实演示转化为密集且逼真的训练分布。\textsc{DexNinja}：(i) 从真实采集数据中重建对象实例，(ii) 在类别级约束下随机化具有物理意义的参数，以及(iii) 利用一个将机器人动力学、触觉接触与可变形切割耦合的自定义可微分仿真器，生成增强的灵巧操作片段。我们在一个灵巧食物切片任务上评估了\textsc{DexNinja}，结果表明：(1) 借助数十条真实演示和数百条增强仿真数据，成功率可达60\%以上；(2) 当仅使用超过20\%的真实数据时，增强数据通过仿真到现实迁移能持续提升成功率；(3) 所得策略能够泛化到形状和尺寸各异的分布外对象。

Authors: Haozhe Lou, Runyi Yang, Wanqi Zhong, Caiyun Liu, Yicheng Liu, Wenhao Liu, Wenlong Ma, Jiawei Xia, Kanzhi Wu, Danda Pani Paudel, Luc Van Gool, Hang Zhao, Yiming Li

Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions for Embodiment Capability Discovery RLRobot

Generative Flow Network task generation embodiment-specific capabilities curriculum learning language-conditioned policy

简要说明：FOSA通过生成流网络构建符号任务骨架，并将策略学习性能作为奖励信号，在异构机器人平台上发现接近能力边界的多样化可执行任务，蒸馏后提升未知复杂长时任务的性能。

TLDR: FOSA discovers embodiment-specific robot capabilities by learning a Generative Flow Network that constructs symbolic task skeletons, compiled into simulation environments where policy-learning performance rewards the generator, improving performance on unseen complex tasks after distillation.

Abstract: Achieving complex, long-horizon robot behavior remains challenging because successful execution depends on skills grounded in a robot's physical affordances. Existing training-task distributions are often handcrafted or sampled from large language models (LLMs), relying on semantic plausibility rather than embodiment-specific feasibility. This mismatch can produce curricula that are too difficult, redundant, or blind to non-obvious but learnable behaviors. We propose Generative Flow on Symbolic Abstractions (FOSA), a framework for discovering embodiment-specific capabilities by learning a grounded task generator. FOSA parameterizes an abstract policy as a Generative Flow Network that constructs symbolic task skeletons. Each skeleton is compiled into a simulation environment, where low-level policy-learning performance provides the reward signal for the abstract policy. Across heterogeneous robot platforms, FOSA discovers diverse and executable tasks near the robot's empirical capability frontier. After distilling the discovered task policies into a single language-conditioned policy, FOSA improves performance on unseen complex and long-horizon tasks. The code and demonstration videos are available at https://www.youwei-yu.com/fosa.

摘要（中文）：实现复杂、长时程的机器人行为仍然具有挑战性，因为成功的执行依赖于植根于机器人物理可实现性（affordances）的技能。现有的训练任务分布通常依赖人工设计或从大型语言模型（LLMs）中采样，侧重于语义合理性，而忽视了基于具体本体（embodiment）的可行性。这种不匹配可能导致生成的课程任务过于困难、冗余，或忽略那些看似不明显但可学习的行为。我们提出了一种名为符号抽象上的生成流（FOSA）框架，通过学习一个具身（grounded）任务生成器，来自动发现本体特有的能力。FOSA将抽象策略参数化为一个生成流网络（Generative Flow Network），用于构建符号化任务骨架。每个骨架被编译为仿真环境，并通过底层策略学习性能提供抽象策略的奖励信号。在异构机器人平台上，FOSA能够在机器人的经验能力边界附近发现多样化且可执行的任务。通过将发现的任务策略蒸馏为单一的语言条件策略，FOSA在未见过的复杂和长时程任务上显著提升了性能。代码和演示视频可在 https://www.youwei-yu.com/fosa 获取。

Authors: Youwei Yu, Lantao Liu

Force-Modulated Dexterity: Unified Compliance for Contact-Rich Manipulation Manipulation

contact-rich manipulation teleoperation compliance control force-driven correction dexterous manipulation

简要说明：FOMO-Dex 提出了一种统一的柔顺控制方法，用于遥操作接触丰富的操作任务，可减少接触力并提升后续策略学习的数据质量。

TLDR: FOMO-Dex introduces a unified compliance formulation for teleoperated contact-rich manipulation, reducing contact forces and improving demonstration quality for downstream policy learning.

Abstract: Teleoperation is widely used to collect high-quality demonstrations for robot learning. Dexterous manipulation, however, requires coordinated control of motion and contact forces. Operators can specify motion, but struggle to reproduce the subtle force adjustments of human manipulation without feeling the robot's contacts. We introduce Force-Modulated Dexterity (FOMO-Dex), a unified compliance formulation for contact-rich manipulation. FOMO-Dex expresses nominal actions in coordinates defined by task geometry and contact structure. It applies force-driven motion corrections along selected directions while leaving the remaining command components unchanged. Across card picking, paper cutting, screwdriving, and nut-and-bolt assembly, FOMO-Dex reduces excessive contact forces compared with stiff control. A user study shows that operators collect more successful demonstration data per hour after brief practice. For policy learning, imitating the corrected actions improves card-picking success over imitating raw operator commands. Policies trained on FOMO-Dex demonstrations also achieve more rotation in nut-and-bolt manipulation and screwdriving than those trained on demonstrations collected with the stiff controller. Videos are shown on https://yingyuan0414.github.io/fomo-dex/ .

摘要（中文）：遥操作被广泛用于采集机器人学习所需的高质量示范数据。然而，灵巧操作要求对运动和接触力进行协调控制。操作者可以指定运动，但若无法感知机器人的接触情况，则难以复现人类操作中细微的力调节过程。我们提出了力调制灵巧操作（Force-Modulated Dexterity, FOMO-Dex），一种面向接触丰富操作任务的统一柔顺控制框架。FOMO-Dex 在由任务几何和接触结构定义的坐标系中表达标称动作，并沿选定方向施加力驱动的运动修正，同时保持其余指令分量不变。在取牌、剪纸、拧螺丝和螺母螺栓装配等任务中，与刚性控制相比，FOMO-Dex 有效降低了过大的接触力。用户研究表明，操作者经过简短练习后，每小时收集到的成功示范数据显著增多。在策略学习方面，模仿修正后的动作比模仿操作者的原始指令在取牌任务中取得了更高的成功率。与使用刚性控制器采集的示范相比，基于 FOMO-Dex 示范训练的策略在螺母螺栓操作和拧螺丝任务中实现了更大的旋转量。相关视频见 https://yingyuan0414.github.io/fomo-dex/ 。

Authors: Ying Yuan, David Held, Jitendra Malik, Haozhi Qi

D-World: An Explicit World-Language-Action Model with Recursive Self-Improvement under Dual Control Manipulation

digital twin recursive self-improvement dual control real-to-sim-to-real simulation-based planning

简要说明：D-World 提出了一种显式的世界-语言-动作模型，在真实机器人执行过程中通过数字孪生的迭代修正实现递归自我改进，并利用双控制理论在任务推进与模型误差探测之间取得平衡。

TLDR: D-World introduces an explicit world-language-action model that iteratively refines a digital twin of the scene during real-robot execution, combining dual control theory to balance task progress with model-error probing.

Abstract: Frontier large language models (LLMs) now reason about space well enough to program robots, yet the world models behind robot policies are implicit, held in network weights or predicted video, and cannot be inspected or corrected directly. We present D-World, an explicit world-language-action model built on the Sense, Plan and Act decomposition. A perception agent writes the scene as an executable digital twin using generated vision and geometry code. A planning agent searches for actions in simulation and, after each executed action chunk, revises the twin's object states and named physical parameters against what the robot measured. A parameter revision is accepted only if replaying the latest chunk does not increase any measured residual beyond its tolerance, and every chunk is checked in the updated twin before it runs. Structural mismatches return to perception for reconstruction. We call this measurement-grounded cycle of correction and revision recursive self-improvement (RSI), in which the LLM stays frozen while the world it acts in improves. We model the choice of actions that both advance the task and expose model error as a dual control problem and show that the cost of incorporating evidence into the twin sets the threshold at which probing pays, so cheap local revision counteracts the turn-off of cautious controllers. Each episode runs a real-to-sim-to-real loop, and its recorded twins can be refitted and re-rendered offline into higher-fidelity environments for post-training. Because perception and planning communicate only through the twin and language, either can be replaced by a learned model, and since inference dominates the loop, the loop speeds up with faster models. On a dual-arm robot, towel and toaster tasks show local revisions, such as one reducing the bread's rendered-depth residual from 22.4 to 1.5 mm, that let execution continue without reconstruction.

摘要（中文）：前沿大型语言模型（LLMs）如今已具备足够的空间推理能力来为机器人编程，然而机器人策略背后的世界模型仍是隐式的，存储于网络权重或预测视频中，无法被直接检查或修正。我们提出D-World，一种基于“感知-规划-执行”（Sense, Plan and Act）分解的显式世界-语言-动作模型。感知智能体通过生成的视觉与几何代码将场景编写为可执行的数字孪生。规划智能体在仿真中搜索动作，并在每个执行的动作片段之后，依据机器人实测结果修正孪生中的物体状态及命名的物理参数。参数修正仅在重放最新动作片段不使任何实测残差超出其容差时被接受，且每个动作片段在运行前都需在更新后的孪生中通过校验。结构不匹配则返回感知模块进行重建。我们将这种以测量为根基的修正与修订循环称为递归自我改进（RSI），在此过程中LLM保持冻结，而其作用的世界则持续改善。我们将既推进任务又暴露模型误差的动作选择建模为对偶控制问题，并证明将证据纳入孪生的成本决定了“探索性探测”何时值得付出，因此廉价的局部修订能够抵消谨慎控制器趋于停止探索的倾向。每个回合都运行一次“真实-仿真-真实”闭环，其记录的孪生可离线重新拟合并渲染为更高保真度的环境，用于后续训练。由于感知与规划仅通过孪生和语言进行通信，二者均可替换为学习模型；又因推理主导该闭环，闭环速度随模型加速而提升。在双臂机器人上，毛巾与烤面包机任务展示了局部修订的效果，例如将面包的渲染深度残差从22.4毫米降至1.5毫米，从而使执行无需重建即可继续进行。

Authors: Xuan Wen, Baichao Wang

Task-Space Motion-Force Nonlinear Model Predictive Control for Precise and Compliant Control under Uncertainties Locomotion

Nonlinear Model Predictive Control task-space force control impedance control compliant control quadruped locomotion

简要说明：本文提出了一种统一的任务空间运动-力NMPC框架，可跨机器人平台泛化，在不确定条件下实现精确且柔顺的控制，并在机械臂和四足机器人上进行了实物验证。

TLDR: This paper proposes a unified NMPC framework for task-space motion and force control that generalizes across robotic platforms, achieving precise and compliant control under uncertainties with real-robot validation on a manipulator and a quadruped.

Abstract: In Nonlinear Model Predictive Control (NMPC), the control law is implicitly determined by the solution of an Optimal Control Problem (OCP). Consequently, OCP design is often tailored to specific platforms and tasks, demanding extensive expert knowledge and tuning effort. To address this, we propose a unified NMPC framework that directly plans and controls the robot joints subject to task-space motion and force requirements and is capable of seamlessly generalizing across multiple robotic platforms and diverse tasks. Furthermore, optimization-based methods often treat interactions as rigid contacts, making the torque solution sensitive to the modeling errors of the robot dynamics and the environment. We study the intrinsic task-space impedance of our proposed controller, its partial contraction for differential stability and differential passivity under unmodeled interactions. As a result, our framework enables closing the force-feedback loop in the high-level planning layer to achieve precise motion-force tracking performance, addressing the long-standing challenge of force-feedback NMPC. Finally, we validate our framework on physical hardware, demonstrating hybrid motion-force control on a redundant manipulator and compliant locomotion on a quadruped, while preserving core NMPC advantages such as hard constraint satisfaction, optimal redundancy exploitation, and real-time planning under unforeseen interactions.

摘要（中文）：在非线性模型预测控制（NMPC）中，控制律由最优控制问题（OCP）的解隐式确定。因此，OCP的设计往往针对特定平台和任务量身定制，需要大量的专家知识和调参工作。为解决这一问题，我们提出了一种统一的NMPC框架，该框架直接对机器人关节进行规划与控制，同时满足任务空间中的运动与力需求，并能够无缝泛化至多种机器人平台及多样化任务。此外，基于优化的方法通常将交互视为刚性接触，使得力矩解对机器人动力学及环境建模误差较为敏感。我们研究了所提控制器固有的任务空间阻抗、其在未建模交互下的微分稳定性部分收缩性以及微分无源性。由此，我们的框架能够在高层规划层闭合力反馈回路，实现精确的运动-力跟踪性能，从而解决力反馈NMPC这一长期挑战。最后，我们在物理硬件上验证了该框架，展示了在冗余机械臂上的混合运动-力控制以及四足机器人上的柔顺行走，同时保留了NMPC的核心优势，如硬约束满足、最优冗余利用以及在意外交互下的实时规划能力。

Authors: Quang-Nam Nguyen, Ludovic Righetti

MOSAIC: Mode- and Support-Aware Inference-Time Control of Robot Diffusion Models Manipulation

inference-time control diffusion models robot priors importance weighting mode preservation

简要说明：MOSAIC 提出了一种无梯度的、模式感知的推理时控制框架，用于预训练机器人扩散模型，通过重要性加权噪声扰动和支持感知惩罚适应新的部署约束。

TLDR: MOSAIC introduces a gradient-free, mode-aware framework for inference-time control of pretrained robot diffusion models, adapting them to new deployment constraints via importance-weighted noise perturbations and support-aware penalties.

Abstract: Generative policies such as diffusion models provide expressive data-driven priors for robot behavior, yet the situations a robot faces at execution time rarely match its training data and impose constraints and objectives the policy never learned. Existing inference-time guidance methods either rely on gradients that can push samples away from the learned prior, or on sampling procedures that can be inefficient, collapse modes, or average them into out-of-distribution predictions. We introduce MOSAIC, a mode- and support-aware framework for gradient-free inference-time control of robotic diffusion models. MOSAIC treats the initial noise and all stochastic reverse-step perturbations as a joint input to the pretrained denoising process and adapts a distribution over this input using importance weights computed from fully denoised outputs. Physical feasibility and consistency with the learned support are balanced using adaptive penalties, while mode-wise importance-weighted updates preserve modes and avoid destructive averaging. The same formulation can jointly steer multiple independently trained diffusion models through shared coupling costs, enabling coordinated behavior without requiring a joint model. We evaluate MOSAIC on navigation, dexterous grasping, motion planning with unseen geometry, and collaborative box manipulation with independently trained robot priors. Across these settings, MOSAIC adapts and composes frozen diffusion priors under new deployment constraints without retraining.

摘要（中文）：生成式策略（如扩散模型）为机器人行为提供了富有表现力的数据驱动先验，然而机器人在执行时所面临的情境很少与其训练数据完全一致，并且这些情境往往施加了策略从未学习过的约束与目标。现有的推理时引导方法要么依赖可能将样本推离所学先验的梯度，要么依赖可能效率低下、导致模式坍缩或将模式平均为分布外预测的采样过程。 我们提出MOSAIC，一种面向机器人扩散模型的无需梯度的推理时控制框架，兼顾模式保持与支撑集感知。MOSAIC将初始噪声及所有随机反向步骤扰动视为预训练去噪过程的联合输入，并利用由完全去噪输出计算得到的重要性权重来调整该输入上的分布。通过自适应惩罚项在物理可行性与所学支撑集一致性之间取得平衡，同时基于模式的重要性加权更新保留了模式并避免了破坏性平均。 该公式还可通过共享耦合代价联合引导多个独立训练的扩散模型，从而在无需联合模型的情况下实现协同行为。我们在导航、灵巧抓取、含未见几何结构的运动规划以及基于独立训练机器人先验的协作搬运箱体任务上对MOSAIC进行了评估。在所有这些场景中，MOSAIC无需重新训练即可在新型部署约束下自适应并组合冻结的扩散先验。

Authors: Sabrina Bodmer, Rahel Rickenbach, René Zurbrügg, Melanie N. Zeilinger, Colin Jones

UniLAP: A Unified Latent Action Policy for Cross-Embodiment Manipulation VLA

Latent Action Models Flow Matching Cross-Embodiment Manipulation Vision-Language-Action

简要说明：UniLAP 提出了一种统一的连续潜在动作策略，通过流匹配和无标签运动目标学习跨具身操作策略，在多种操作任务上优于现有方法。

TLDR: UniLAP introduces a unified continuous latent-action policy that uses flow matching and a label-free motion target to learn embodiment-agnostic manipulation policies, outperforming existing methods on hand pose forecasting, single-arm and humanoid manipulation, and real-world deployment.

Abstract: Latent Action Models (LAMs) can capture manipulation priors from action-free videos, but discrete latents usually impose a granularity bottleneck, limiting their ability to represent fine-grained action. Recent continuous alternatives mitigate this, but they are typically used as proxies for world modeling and require a further planning step to produce executable actions. We thus introduce UniLAP, a unified continuous latent-action policy that models the latent space via flow matching and bypasses reliance on future frames during inference. By distilling a LAM teacher with a flow-adaptive objective, UniLAP inherits the teacher's action representation while retaining the multimodal distribution of feasible behaviors. To decouple latent representations from task-irrelevant appearance, we extract a label-free motion target to isolate relevant kinematic cues from spurious visual dynamics. With the established embodiment-agnostic latent manifold, UniLAP can be easily adapted to novel platforms. Pretrained on multi-source videos at a compact 1.1B parameter scale, UniLAP outperforms state-of-the-art latent-action and Vision-Language-Action (VLA) baselines across hand pose forecasting, single-arm and humanoid manipulation, and real-world deployment.

摘要（中文）：潜在动作模型（LAMs）能够从无动作视频中捕获操作先验，但离散潜变量通常会造成粒度瓶颈，限制其表示细粒度动作的能力。最近的连续替代方法缓解了这一问题，但它们通常仅作为世界建模的代理，需要额外的规划步骤才能生成可执行动作。为此，我们提出UniLAP，一种统一的连续潜动作策略，通过流匹配对潜空间进行建模，并在推理阶段摆脱对未来帧的依赖。通过使用流自适应目标蒸馏LAM教师模型，UniLAP继承了教师的动作表示，同时保留了可行行为的多模态分布。为将潜表示与任务无关的外观解耦，我们提取一种无标签的运动目标，以从虚假的视觉动态中分离出相关的运动学线索。凭借建立的与具身无关的潜流形，UniLAP可轻松适配新平台。UniLAP在紧凑的11亿参数规模下于多源视频上预训练，在手部姿态预测、单臂与仿人操作以及真实世界部署等任务中均优于最先进的潜动作和视觉-语言-动作（VLA）基线方法。

Authors: Lei Yao, Qiao Feng, Mutian Tong, Qihao Yun, Lap-Pui Chau, Lingjie Liu

Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention VLA

physical AI proactive agent intervention timing streaming model robot evaluation

简要说明：本文提出了主动物理AI概念，即AI系统持续观察世界并在人类明确请求之前主动干预，并开发了端到端系统ProAgent，包含流式时机模型和响应模型，在真实机器人上验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces Proactive Physical AI, where AI systems continuously observe the world and intervene before explicit human requests, and presents ProAgent, an end-to-end system with a streaming timing model and a response model, validated on real robots.

Abstract: Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Experiments demonstrate strong proactive performance under both explicit objectives and standing roles, combining more accurate intervention timing with fewer false triggers than the source-backbone baseline. Real-robot evaluations further demonstrate ProAgent's ability to identify emerging needs and translate them into appropriate physical actions.

摘要（中文）：物理人工智能通常围绕明确指定的任务来构建：给定目标或指令，系统进行感知、推理并采取行动。然而，在许多现实场景中，重要任务往往在人们明确表达之前，就从持续变化的世界状态中涌现出来。我们将这一互补性问题研究为“主动物理人工智能”，即人工智能系统持续观察物理世界，识别需要干预的情境，并在恰当的时间主动采取相应行动。我们开发了ProAgent，一个端到端系统，由两个组件构成：一个Jev风格的主动时机模型（称为StreamingJev），用于判断是否需要干预以及何时干预；以及一个响应模型，用于生成对人的回应或调用可用设备能力来执行物理操作。为支持规模化学习，我们构建了自动化数据处理管道，将视频转化为主动时机的监督信号。实验表明，在明确目标与持续角色两种情境下，ProAgent均展现出较强的主动性能，与源骨干基线相比，其干预时机更为精准，且误触发更少。真实机器人评估进一步证明了ProAgent能够识别涌现需求并将其转化为适当的物理行动。

Human-Like Redundancy Resolution for Real-Time Bimanual Humanoid Teleoperation HumanoidEmbodied

redundancy resolution bimanual teleoperation humanoid elbow guidance singularity-robust tracking

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于实时双手机器人遥操作的人性化冗余解析框架，结合自适应肘部引导与奇异鲁棒腕部跟踪，以稳定手臂配置并提高跟踪精度。

TLDR: This paper presents a human-like redundancy-resolution framework for real-time bimanual humanoid teleoperation, combining adaptive elbow guidance with singularity-robust wrist tracking to stabilize arm configurations and improve tracking accuracy.

Abstract: Real-time bimanual humanoid teleoperation requires accurate wrist tracking while keeping arm configurations predictable. Because a 7-DoF arm admits multiple elbow configurations for the same wrist pose, wrist-only tracking can cause elbow drift or abrupt configuration changes. Fixed anthropomorphic constraints can stabilize elbow posture, but they can also block the redundant adjustments needed near singular configurations. We propose a human-like redundancy-resolution framework that combines adaptive elbow guidance with singularity-robust wrist tracking. Shoulder-wrist geometric retargeting generates robot-scale wrist targets. An adaptive elbow-offset criterion uses the offset direction to guide posture and scales this guidance by the offset magnitude, so the redundant degree of freedom is progressively released as the human arm straightens. A hierarchical velocity solver prioritizes wrist tracking and projects the adaptive elbow guidance into the wrist-task null space. In a fixed-wrist-target ablation, adaptive guidance reduces mean elbow-direction error by 54.4% compared with removing this guidance. In a workspace-boundary stress test, singularity-robust tracking reduces peak raw joint-velocity demand by 97.9% compared with the undamped pseudoinverse. Real-world bimanual tasks and cross-platform retargeting show applicability across robot morphologies.

摘要（中文）：实时双臂类人远程操作要求在保持臂部构型可预测的同时，实现精准的手腕跟踪。由于七自由度手臂在相同手腕位姿下可对应多种肘部构型，仅依赖手腕跟踪可能导致肘部漂移或构型突变。固定的人体形态约束虽能稳定肘部姿态，但亦可能阻碍接近奇异构型时所需的冗余调节。我们提出了一种融合自适应肘部引导与奇异鲁棒手腕跟踪的类人冗余解析框架。肩-腕几何重定向生成机器人尺度下的手腕目标。自适应肘部偏移准则利用偏移方向引导姿态，并依据偏移幅度缩放引导强度，从而在人体手臂趋于伸直时逐步释放冗余自由度。分层速度求解器优先保证手腕跟踪，并将自适应肘部引导投影至手腕任务零空间中。在固定手腕目标的消融实验中，与去除该引导相比，自适应引导使平均肘部方向误差降低了54.4%。在工作空间边界压力测试中，与无阻尼伪逆方法相比，奇异鲁棒跟踪将峰值原始关节速度需求降低了97.9%。真实双臂任务与跨平台重定向实验验证了该方法在多种机器人形态下的适用性。

Authors: Chao Tan, Ming Shin Cindy Sung, Shuxian Liang, Chaoqun Wan, Zhen Huang, Xian-Sheng Hua

CopyQuad: Quadrupedal Skill Transfer from a Single Side-View Video Without a Depth Model Locomotion

quadrupedal imitation video-to-robot retargeting side-view video zero-shot deployment

简要说明：CopyQuad 提出了一种用于四足模仿的视频到机器人流程，省略了单目深度或3D重建，而是将缺失的侧向轴固定到机器人自身站距上，实现了从单段侧视视频到真实四足机器人的零样本技能迁移。

TLDR: CopyQuad introduces a video-to-robot pipeline for quadrupedal imitation that omits monocular depth or 3D reconstruction, instead fixing the missing lateral axis to the robot's stance width, enabling zero-shot skill transfer from a single side-view video to real quadruped robots.

Abstract: Video-to-robot pipelines for quadrupedal imitation insert a learned lifting stage, either a monocular depth model or a per-clip 3D reconstruction, to recover the one axis a side-view camera cannot see. We present CopyQuad, which omits that stage and pins the missing axis to the robot's own stance width instead. The setting is side-view footage of sagittally dominated motion, where limb motion is almost entirely in the image plane. A frozen 2D keypoint detector and a fixed analytic retargeting then turn a single uncalibrated clip into a robot reference whose foot targets are reachable by construction, so no per-clip trajectory optimization is needed. One phase-indexed reward structure, whose only per-behavior freedom is three scalars from a shared sweep, learns a dog walk, a horse walk, a horse trot and two non-periodic gestures, all deployed zero-shot on hardware. We then measure what omitting the axis costs. In a training-free rigidity test, a video depth model varies the distance between the animal's hips by $40$ to $107\%$ of its own mean and a single-image metric model by $22$ to $58\%$, though that distance cannot move. Motion capture puts the true lateral paw travel of a dog walk at $4.5$ cm peak to peak, a mean deviation near $1.4$ cm against the $3.5$ cm of lateral foot error our policies already leave, so the discarded axis sits below the pipeline's resolution. Depth repaired to feasibility never beats the constant, and the unrepaired estimates put the robot on the ground.

摘要（中文）：视频到机器人的四足模仿流程中，通常会加入一个学习型提升阶段——无论是单目深度模型还是逐片段三维重建——用以恢复侧视相机无法观测的那一轴信息。我们提出了CopyQuad，该方法省略了这一阶段，并将缺失的轴固定为机器人自身的站立宽度。其应用场景为矢状面主导运动的侧视视频，其中肢体运动几乎完全处于图像平面内。通过冻结的二维关键点检测器与固定的解析式重定向，单段未标定的视频片段即可直接转化为机器人参考动作，且其足部目标在构造上即可达，无需针对每个片段进行轨迹优化。一个以相位为索引的奖励结构——每个行为仅需共享扫描范围内的三个标量参数——即可学习狗走、马走、马快步以及两种非周期性姿态，并全部在硬件上零样本部署。随后，我们量化了省略该轴带来的代价。在免训练的刚性测试中，视频深度模型将动物髋部距离的变化幅度维持在自身平均值的40%至107%之间，而单图像度量模型则为22%至58%，尽管该距离在物理上无法改变。动作捕捉数据显示，狗走时真实的侧向爪部位移峰值约为4.5厘米，其平均偏差接近1.4厘米，而我们的策略本身已存在约3.5厘米的侧向足部误差，因此被舍弃的轴低于整个流程的分辨率。经深度修复至可行范围的方案从未优于常数设定，而未修复的估计则使机器人能够稳定落于地面。

Authors: Mohamad H. Danesh, Raina Hu, Mengxue Xu, Hsiu-Chin Lin

What Limits Cross-Task Generalization in World Action Models? VLA

world action models inverse dynamics vision-to-action loss cross-task generalization robot manipulation

简要说明：本文通过解耦世界模型与逆动力学模型，研究世界动作模型中的跨任务泛化失败原因，并提出视觉到动作损失，将生成未来帧的执行成功率从接近零提升至47%。

TLDR: This paper investigates cross-task generalization failures in world action models by decoupling world models from inverse-dynamics models and introduces a vision-to-action loss to improve execution success of generated futures from near zero to 47%.

Abstract: Cross-task generalization remains difficult for world action models (WAMs), even when their predicted futures depict plausible manipulation. This gap can be attributed directly: we make this gap directly testable by decoupling a WAM into a world model and an inverse-dynamics model (IDM), then holding the IDM fixed while replacing the source of future images. We introduce Align Once, Evaluate Everywhere (AoE), a camera-space inverse-dynamics model pretrained on large-scale robot data, which provides this recovery interface for different future sources across tasks and environments. Through it, we find that actions recovered from recorded futures of unseen tasks execute almost as well as replayed demonstrations, whereas futures predicted by world models collapse across benchmarks. The failures are not generic: they concentrate on the gripper and interaction geometry while generation capacity is spent on task-irrelevant background. This diagnosis suggests that supervision should target exactly these regions. We therefore introduce the vision-to-action (VITA) loss, which passes generated futures through the frozen AoE and penalizes discrepancies in the recovered actions, redirecting generation toward action-relevant detail. Across two world models and three manipulation benchmarks, this simple change raises the execution success of generated futures from near zero to 47.0%. The same loss also transfers to WAMs and yields consistent gains in native control.

摘要（中文）：跨任务泛化对于世界动作模型（WAMs）而言仍然是一大难题，即便其预测的未来画面呈现出合理的操作过程。这一差距可以直接归因于——我们通过将WAM解耦为世界模型与逆动力学模型（IDM），并在固定IDM的同时替换未来图像的来源，使这一差距变得可直接检验。我们提出了“一次对齐，处处评估”（Align Once, Evaluate Everywhere, AoE）方法，这是一种在大规模机器人数据上预训练的相机空间逆动力学模型，为不同任务和环境中的多种未来来源提供了这一恢复接口。通过该模型，我们发现从未见任务记录的未来画面中恢复的动作，其执行效果几乎与回放示范相当，而世界模型预测的未来画面在各基准测试中则全面失效。这些失败并非普遍性的：它们集中在夹爪及交互几何结构上，而生成能力却被消耗在与任务无关的背景上。这一诊断表明，监督应精准针对这些区域。为此，我们引入了视觉到动作（VITA）损失，该损失将生成的未来画面通过冻结的AoE模型，并对恢复出的动作差异进行惩罚，从而将生成过程引导至与动作相关的细节上。在两个世界模型和三个操作基准测试中，这一简单改动将生成未来画面的执行成功率从接近零提升至47.0%。该损失同样可迁移至WAMs，并在原生控制中带来一致的性能提升。

Authors: Chen Zhao, Zipeng Ye, Yihan Lin, Yuchen Xie, Jing Zhang

Design and Analysis of a Nonlinear Parallel Mechanism Coupling for Dynamic Humanoid Legs HumanoidEmbodied

parallel mechanism nonlinear knee-ankle coupling proximal actuation humanoid legs dynamic locomotion

简要说明：本文提出了一种新型的串并联人形腿部设计，通过非线性膝-踝耦合降低远端惯量并优化扭矩/速度分配，并在仿真和硬件上得到验证。

TLDR: This paper presents a novel series-parallel humanoid leg design with a nonlinear knee-ankle coupling that reduces distal inertia and improves torque/speed distribution for dynamic locomotion, validated in simulation and hardware.

Abstract: Humanoids increasingly demand lightweight leg mechanisms for agile, dynamic, and energy-efficient locomotion. Reducing distal inertia through proximal actuation has thus become a common design goal. Yet, compact transmissions that preserve torque capability and efficient force transmission remain hard to achieve. This paper presents a novel series-parallel leg design combining a knee parallel mechanism, an ankle parallel mechanism, and a nonlinear knee-ankle coupling where all actuators placed closer to the hip. As the knee flexes, the coupling passively assists ankle dorsiflexion for foot clearance and, as it extends it assists plantarflexion for push-off, redistributing ankle load through the knee transmission. We derive the coupling's nonlinear transmission models and validate them in simulation and on hardware. The design shows that the shared transmission lets both joints draw on each other's actuator capacity by easing the knee's peak torque demand under load and the ankle's peak speed demand during fast motion. %Together With the leg's proximal actuator placement, the leg achieves an effective reflected mass of 0.37kg at the foot for a 6kg leg, demonstrating very low distal leg inertia for dynamic humanoid robots.

摘要（中文）：人形机器人日益需要轻量化腿部机构，以实现敏捷、动态且高效的运动。因此，通过近端驱动来降低远端惯量已成为常见的设计目标。然而，既能保持扭矩能力又能实现高效力传递的紧凑型传动装置仍然难以实现。本文提出了一种新颖的串并联腿部设计，结合了膝关节并联机构、踝关节并联机构以及非线性膝-踝耦合，所有驱动器均布置在更靠近髋关节的位置。当膝关节弯曲时，耦合机构被动辅助踝关节背屈以实现足部离地；当膝关节伸展时，耦合机构辅助踝关节跖屈以完成蹬伸动作，从而通过膝关节传动重新分配踝关节载荷。我们推导了该耦合机构的非线性传动模型，并在仿真和硬件平台上进行了验证。实验结果表明，共享传动使两个关节能够利用彼此的驱动器能力，在负载下缓解膝关节的峰值扭矩需求，并在快速运动期间缓解踝关节的峰值速度需求。结合腿部近端驱动器布置，该腿部在6kg质量下实现了足部等效反射质量0.37kg，展现了适用于动态人形机器人的极低远端腿部惯量。

Authors: Rohit Kumar, Heiner Peters, Felix Wiebe, Franek Stark, Janne Janzen, Dennis Mronga, Shubham Vyas, Frank Kirchner

G$^2$WAM: World Action Models for Efficient and Geometry Grounded Image-Goal Navigation WorldModel

image-goal navigation world action model latent space prediction scene-coordinate localization closed-loop navigation

简要说明：G2WAM是一种用于图像目标导航的世界动作模型，通过学习场景坐标定位模块将空间线索锚定在共同参考框架中，在潜空间中联合预测未来状态和动作，无需显式3D重建，显著提升轨迹预测和闭环导航性能。

TLDR: G2WAM is a world action model for image-goal navigation that learns a scene-coordinate localization module to ground spatial cues in a common reference frame, jointly predicts future states and actions in latent space without explicit 3D reconstruction, achieving significant improvements in trajectory prediction and closed-loop navigation.

Abstract: World models capture environment dynamics and support counterfactual reasoning for planning. In image-goal navigation, where the target often lies beyond the current field of view, the agent must not only model environmental dynamics but also maintain a persistent spatial memory of the scene. Existing approaches either introduce spatial context by fine-tuning pretrained models on the target task, which underexploits their spatial priors, or rely on external 3D reconstruction, which is computationally expensive for real-world deployment. In this paper, we propose the Geometry Grounded World Action Model (G$^2$WAM) for image-goal navigation. G$^2$WAM encodes spatial cues through a learned scene-coordinate localization module that anchors the current, goal, and history frames in a common reference frame, yielding a stable and consistent spatial context that enables efficient navigation without explicit 3D reconstruction. Following the world-action-model paradigm, G$^2$WAM jointly predicts future states and actions, eliminating the need for costly cross-entropy method (CEM) style planning. In addition, G$^2$WAM operates entirely in latent space, avoiding the computational burden of pixel-level reconstruction and substantially reducing inference cost. Across four trajectory prediction benchmarks, G$^2$WAM reduces average ATE and RPE by 40.1% and 35.2%, respectively. In closed-loop navigation experiments, it improves the success rate from 54.0% to 63.0% and the success weighted by path length (SPL) from 36.4% to 59.2%, while maintaining high efficiency.

摘要（中文）：世界模型能够捕捉环境动态，并支持用于规划的反事实推理。在图像目标导航任务中，目标往往位于当前视野之外，智能体不仅需要建模环境动态，还必须维持对场景的持续性空间记忆。现有方法要么通过在目标任务上对预训练模型进行微调来引入空间上下文，但这种方式未能充分利用其空间先验知识；要么依赖外部三维重建，而这在实际部署中计算成本过高。本文提出了一种用于图像目标导航的几何 grounding 世界动作模型（G$^2$WAM）。G$^2$WAM 通过一个学习得到的场景坐标定位模块对空间线索进行编码，将当前帧、目标帧和历史帧锚定在一个共同的参考坐标系中，从而提供稳定且一致的空间上下文，使智能体无需显式三维重建即可实现高效导航。遵循世界动作模型范式，G$^2$WAM 联合预测未来状态和动作，无需使用计算代价高昂的交叉熵方法（CEM）式规划。此外，G$^2$WAM 完全在潜空间中运行，避免了像素级重建的计算负担，大幅降低了推理成本。在四个轨迹预测基准上，G$^2$WAM 将平均绝对轨迹误差（ATE）和相对位姿误差（RPE）分别降低了40.1%和35.2%。在闭环导航实验中，该方法将成功率从54.0%提升至63.0%，将路径长度加权成功率（SPL）从36.4%提升至59.2%，同时保持了较高的效率。

Authors: Ke Gui, Chenghao Shi, Ziyue Wang, Longwen Chen, Xieyuanli Chen, Huimin Lu

Learning Reachability-Based Safety Representations for Real-Time Robot Navigation in Unknown and Dynamic Environments RLRobot

Hamilton-Jacobi reachability neural implicit representations model predictive control control barrier functions safe robot navigation

简要说明：本论文为实时安全机器人导航开发了Hamilton-Jacobi可达性值函数的神经隐式表示，仅学习动力学修正项以确保安全，并在仿真和真实地空机器人上展示了改进的避碰能力，第五种方法可扩展到13状态系统。

TLDR: This dissertation develops neural implicit representations of Hamilton-Jacobi reachability value functions for real-time safe robot navigation, learning only a dynamics correction term to ensure safety despite approximation errors, and demonstrates improved collision avoidance in simulation and on real ground and aerial robots, with a fifth method scaling to 13-state systems.

Abstract: Safe robot navigation in unknown, dynamic environments requires more than geometric collision checking: a robot still far from an obstacle may be unable to avoid it because of its speed, orientation, or the obstacle's motion. Hamilton--Jacobi (HJ) reachability analysis captures this in a value function whose sign separates states that admit a safe continuation from those where collision is unavoidable, but computing it online for every newly observed environment is too expensive. This dissertation trains neural implicit representations offline on reachability solutions to give optimization-based controllers this information in real time. Since the value function never exceeds the constraint, it equals a directly computed constraint, such as a signed distance, minus a nonnegative dynamics correction. Learning only this correction keeps represented obstacles outside the predicted safe set despite approximation errors. The first two of five methods use the learned function as a terminal constraint in model predictive control, for static local environments and predicted obstacle motion. The next two use it as a barrier candidate in control barrier function safety filters, for static environments and, through pairwise barriers in relative coordinates, for a varying number of moving obstacles. Simulations and hardware experiments on ground and aerial robots show better collision avoidance than geometric and hand-designed baselines, especially for short horizons and moving obstacles. The fifth method replaces the grid-based offline solver, which limits the first four to low-dimensional models. For control-affine dynamics with polytopic inputs, the HJ Hamiltonian is maximized at a vertex, so a parallelizable tree search over vertex inputs can generate training labels. With a loss from the HJ variational inequality, these labels yield barrier candidates for systems with up to 13 states.

摘要（中文）：在未知、动态环境中实现机器人安全导航，仅依靠几何碰撞检测是不够的：一个距离障碍物尚远的机器人，可能因其自身速度、朝向或障碍物的运动而无法避开碰撞。Hamilton-Jacobi (HJ) 可达性分析通过一个值函数来捕捉这一特性，该值函数的符号区分了存在安全延续路径的状态与碰撞不可避免的状态，但针对每个新观测到的环境在线计算该值函数代价过高。本论文在离线阶段对可达性解训练神经隐式表示，从而使基于优化的控制器能够实时获取这一信息。由于值函数从不超过约束值，它等于直接计算的约束（如符号距离）减去一个非负动力学修正项。仅学习这一修正项，可以在存在近似误差的情况下，确保所表示的障碍物始终位于预测安全集之外。五种方法中，前两种将学习到的函数作为模型预测控制中的终端约束，分别适用于静态局部环境和预测的障碍物运动；接下来的两种将其作为控制障碍函数安全滤波器中的障碍函数候选，分别适用于静态环境，以及通过相对坐标下的成对障碍函数适用于数量变化的移动障碍物场景。在地面与空中机器人上进行的仿真与硬件实验表明，相较于几何基线和手工设计的基线方法，该方法在避碰方面表现更优，尤其是在短预测时域和移动障碍物场景下。第五种方法替代了基于网格的离线求解器，后者限制了前四种方法仅适用于低维模型。对于具有多面体输入的控制仿射动力学，HJ哈密顿量在某一顶点处取得最大值，因此对顶点输入进行可并行化的树搜索即可生成训练标签。结合HJ变分不等式构造的损失函数，这些标签可为最多含有13个状态变量的系统生成障碍函数候选。

Authors: Bojan Derajić

DeTac: Dual-branch Decoupling of Texture and Force Signals in Vision-Based Tactile Sensors Manipulation

vision-based tactile sensing signal decoupling dual-branch generative framework mutual supervision robotic manipulation

简要说明：DeTac 提出了一种双分支生成框架，从视觉触觉传感器图像中同时解耦纹理和力信号，通过全图像合成和跨分支互监督提升解耦精度并促进下游机器人任务。

TLDR: DeTac introduces a dual-branch generative framework that decouples texture and force signals from single vision-based tactile sensor images, using full-image synthesis and cross-branch mutual supervision to improve decoupling accuracy and downstream robotics tasks.

Abstract: Vision-based tactile sensors enable fine-grained perception for dexterous robotic manipulation, but current marker-based designs tightly couple surface texture and contact force signals within a single observation. Existing data-driven decoupling methods rely on serial mask-based inpainting, which suffers from mask-sizing dilemmas caused by physical indentation effects, error retention, and lack of real paired data for supervision. To address these challenges, we propose DeTac, a novel dual-branch generative framework that concurrently extracts clean shading and marker images from a single mixed tactile image. DeTac leverages full-image synthesis to naturally bypass mask dependency and introduces a cross-branch synergistic optimization that enables mutual supervision, effectively preventing error retention. Furthermore, we construct a strictly aligned, real-world paired tactile dataset using custom hardware to provide high-quality supervision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DeTac achieves state-of-the-art decoupling accuracy, significantly facilitating downstream surface reconstruction and force estimation tasks while exhibiting cross-sensor generalization.

摘要（中文）：基于视觉的触觉传感器能够实现精细的感知，从而支持灵巧的机器人操作，但现有的基于标记的设计将表面纹理和接触力信号紧密耦合在单一的观测中。现有的数据驱动解耦方法依赖于基于掩码的串行修复，这种方式受制于物理压痕效应引起的掩码尺寸选择难题、误差累积以及缺乏用于监督的真实配对数据。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了DeTac，一种新颖的双分支生成框架，能够从单张混合触觉图像中同时提取干净的阴影图像和标记图像。DeTac利用全图像合成，自然地绕过了对掩码的依赖，并引入了跨分支协同优化，实现相互监督，有效防止误差累积。此外，我们利用定制硬件构建了一个严格对齐的真实世界配对触觉数据集，以提供高质量的监督。大量实验表明，DeTac在解耦精度上达到了最先进水平，显著促进了后续表面重建和力估计任务，同时展现出跨传感器的泛化能力。

Authors: Zhirui Zhang, Yunkai Tang, Jiahang Li, Fan Fei, Jinnuo Zhang, Kairan Ding, Jieji Ren, Yandong Guo, Boxin Shi

PINT: A Unified Model with Shared Predictive Intent for Robot Manipulation VLA

Predictive Intent Vision-Language-Action World Model Robot Manipulation Out-of-Distribution Generalization

简要说明：PINT 是一种统一的机器人操作模型，通过共享的可学习预测意图表示来协调视觉语言模型、视频生成模型和动作专家，从而在仿真和真实双臂任务中提升分布内和分布外泛化能力。

TLDR: PINT is a unified robot manipulation model that coordinates a VLM, video generation model, and action expert through a shared learnable Predictive Intent representation, improving in-distribution and out-of-distribution generalization in simulation and real-world bimanual tasks.

Abstract: Generalist robot manipulation can benefit from pretrained vision-language models (VLMs) for semantic reasoning and video generation models (VGMs) for world modeling. However, existing unified models that directly fuse them through shared attention at multiple layers can make it harder to draw on their specialized capabilities. We introduce PINT, a unified model that coordinates semantic reasoning, world modeling, and action generation through a shared chunk-level Predictive Intent while preserving expert-specific pathways. PINT inserts learnable Intent Tokens into the VLM sequence to form this representation, conditioning both the VGM and an Action Expert (AE). It replaces only the VGM's prompt conditioning and retains the VGM at inference, where the AE reads its representations through one-way attention. Rather than prescribing what Predictive Intent should encode, PINT learns it jointly from the native prediction objectives of the VLM, VGM, and AE, which provide complementary views of the same upcoming task execution. Training uses two stages: Stage 1 freezes the VGM so that future video prediction shapes Predictive Intent with task-relevant future dynamics, while Stage 2 fixes the learned Intent and adapts the VGM and AE. Without embodied pretraining, PINT achieves strong in-distribution (ID) performance and substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, reaching 15.5% on RoboTwin 2.0-Hard compared with 1.8% for Fast-WAM and 3.2% for StarVLA, and 79.5% on LIBERO-Plus compared with 51.5% and 75.0%, respectively. Across five real-world bimanual tasks, PINT reaches 68% ID and 24% OOD success, compared with 35%/9% for pretrained Motus and 67%/35% for pretrained $π_{0.5}$.

摘要（中文）：通用机器人操作可以利用预训练的视觉-语言模型（VLM）进行语义推理，以及视频生成模型（VGM）进行世界建模。然而，现有的统一模型通过多层共享注意力直接融合这两类模型，可能反而难以充分发挥它们各自的专长。我们提出PINT，一种统一模型，通过共享的块级预测意图（Predictive Intent）协调语义推理、世界建模和动作生成，同时保留各专家特有的通路。PINT在VLM序列中插入可学习的意图令牌（Intent Tokens）以形成这一表示，并对VGM和动作专家（AE）进行条件约束。它仅替换VGM的提示条件，并在推理阶段保留VGM，此时AE通过单向注意力读取其表示。PINT并不预先规定预测意图应当编码什么内容，而是从VLM、VGM和AE的原生预测目标中联合学习该意图，这些目标为同一即将执行的任务提供了互补的视角。训练采用两个阶段：第一阶段冻结VGM，使未来视频预测以任务相关的未来动态塑造预测意图；第二阶段固定学到的意图，并适配VGM和AE。在无需具身预训练的情况下，PINT在分布内（ID）任务上表现出色，并显著提升了分布外（OOD）泛化能力，在RoboTwin 2.0-Hard上达到15.5%，而Fast-WAM为1.8%、StarVLA为3.2%；在LIBERO-Plus上达到79.5%，而二者分别为51.5%和75.0%。在五项真实世界双臂任务中，PINT达到68%的ID成功率和24%的OOD成功率，相比之下，预训练的Motus为35%/9%，预训练的π₀.₅为67%/35%。

Authors: Xinyu Guo, Chao Jing, Li Yi, Xingyu Chen, Zhengxing Wu

Constraint-Decomposed Impedance Control from Generative Policy for Articulated Object Manipulation Manipulation

impedance control generative policy articulated object manipulation twist space constraint decomposition

简要说明：本文提出一种约束分解阻抗控制方法，利用生成策略的采样多样性估计可行运动方向，从而在保持任务执行的同时减少铰接物体操作中的约束违反接触载荷。

TLDR: This paper proposes a constraint-decomposed impedance control method that uses the sampling diversity of a generative policy to estimate feasible motion directions in twist space, improving articulated object manipulation by reducing constraint-violating contact loads while maintaining task execution.

Abstract: Articulated object manipulation tasks such as opening doors, tightening bolts, and pulling drawers impose kinematic constraints on a robot end-effector's motion that neural policies may fail to satisfy. Unlike hybrid force-position control that strictly separates force and position control into orthogonal subspaces, impedance control modulates a mechanical impedance system in the form of a virtual inertia, damping, and stiffness. However, selecting task-appropriate impedance gains remains challenging for robot policies. In this paper, we address this problem for the case of manipulating articulated objects. Our constraint-decomposed impedance control method uses the sampling diversity of a generative policy to estimate the feasible motion directions in twist space. The key idea is to infer the feasible and constrained subspaces of twists from an ensemble of trajectories generated by the policy from the same observation. Principal component analysis (PCA) of the end-effector twists determines the feasible twist subspace, which is then used to form 6x6 impedance gain matrices. For many common articulated objects, the feasible twist subspace is independent of the object configuration, so the subspace and resulting gains are estimated once and held fixed during manipulation, minimizing computational overhead. For less common cases where this independence does not hold, we instead estimate a configuration-independent twist subspace of higher dimension that contains the local feasible subspaces, allowing the same fixed-gain strategy to be used. Experiments across simulated and real-world single- and multi-DoF objects show that the proposed method consistently reduces constraint-violating contact loads relative to isotropic impedance control while maintaining task execution.

摘要（中文）：关节式物体操作任务，如开门、拧紧螺栓和拉开抽屉，对机器人末端执行器的运动施加了运动学约束，而神经策略可能无法满足这些约束。与将力控制和位置控制严格分离到正交子空间的混合力位控制不同，阻抗控制通过虚拟惯性、阻尼和刚度的形式调节机械阻抗系统。然而，为机器人策略选择适合任务的阻抗增益仍具挑战性。本文针对操作关节式物体的情况解决了这一问题。我们提出的约束分解阻抗控制方法利用生成式策略的采样多样性来估计扭量空间中的可行运动方向。其关键思想是从策略基于相同观测生成的一组轨迹中推断可行的扭量子空间和受约束的扭量子空间。对末端执行器扭量进行主成分分析（PCA）可确定可行的扭量子空间，进而用于构造6×6阻抗增益矩阵。对于许多常见的关节式物体，可行扭量子空间与物体构型无关，因此该子空间及相应的增益只需估计一次，并在操作过程中保持不变，从而最大程度地减少了计算开销。对于不满足这种独立性的较少见情况，我们转而估计一个维度更高且包含局部可行子空间的构型无关扭量子空间，从而仍可采用相同的固定增益策略。在模拟及真实世界的单自由度与多自由度物体上的实验表明，与各向同性阻抗控制相比，所提方法在保持任务完成的同时，持续减少了违反约束的接触载荷。

Authors: Kyungseo Park, Byeongdo Lim, Jungbin Lim, Minseok Choi, Frank C. Park

ReAP: From Visual Failure Recognition to Action-Conditioned Risk Prediction for Runtime Failure Monitoring Manipulation

failure detection action-conditioned prediction runtime monitoring visual risk prediction generalist robot policies

简要说明：ReAP提出了一种针对通用机器人策略的运行时监控框架，通过视觉检测器识别当前失败，并利用动作条件预测器在学习的失败相关表示空间中预测未来失败风险，以平衡检测准确性和预警及时性。

TLDR: ReAP introduces a runtime monitoring framework for generalist robot policies that detects current failures via a visual detector and predicts future failure risk using an action-conditioned predictor in a learned failure-relevant representation space, balancing detection accuracy and warning timeliness.

Abstract: Despite rapid progress, generalist robot policies remain brittle during execution. Reliable deployment therefore requires runtime monitoring that provides timely warnings of failure. Existing monitors commonly estimate risk from current observations or policy signals without explicitly predicting the future consequences of proposed actions. To anticipate such risks before action execution, we introduce ReAP, a future-aware runtime monitoring framework that combines visual failure recognition with action-conditioned failure prediction. Specifically, ReAP first trains a visual detector on successful and failed rollouts to learn a failure-relevant representation space and estimate current risk. An action-conditioned predictor then forecasts the resulting future representation in this space to estimate future failure risk. At runtime, the detector and predictor provide complementary signals for current-state failure recognition and future-aware risk assessment. Experiments across diverse robot policies in simulation and the real world demonstrate that ReAP effectively balances failure-detection accuracy and warning timeliness.

摘要（中文）：尽管取得了快速进展，通用型机器人策略在执行过程中仍显得脆弱。因此，可靠的部署需要运行时监控，以便及时发出故障预警。现有监控器通常基于当前观测或策略信号来估计风险，而不显式预测所提议动作的未来后果。为了在动作执行前预判此类风险，我们引入了ReAP，一种具备未来感知能力的运行时监控框架，该框架将视觉故障识别与基于动作的故障预测相结合。具体而言，ReAP首先在成功与失败的滚动演示上训练一个视觉检测器，以学习故障相关的表征空间并估计当前风险。随后，一个基于动作的预测器在该表征空间中预测未来的表征，以估计未来的故障风险。在运行时，检测器与预测器为当前状态故障识别及未来风险感知评估提供互补信号。在仿真与真实世界中，涵盖多种机器人策略的实验表明，ReAP有效平衡了故障检测的准确性与预警的及时性。

Authors: Jingyuan Liu, Yunpeng Qing, Changxu Wei, Zhi Hou

PACE: Temporal-Role Tactile Conditioning for Chunk-Based Insertion Policies Manipulation

tactile conditioning insertion policy chunk-based policy contact-rich manipulation visuotactile learning

简要说明：PACE 提出了一种面向分块插入策略的时间角色触觉条件框架，将持续接触状态、突发接触事件和接触后果预测分离到不同通路，在真实机器人和基准插入任务上实现了高成功率。

TLDR: PACE introduces a temporal-role tactile conditioning framework for chunk-based insertion policies, separating persistent contact states, abrupt contact events, and contact-consequence prediction into distinct pathways, achieving high success rates on real-robot and benchmark insertion tasks.

Abstract: Contact-rich insertion requires robots to combine visual alignment with tactile adjustment. However, existing visuotactile chunk-based policies collapse tactile feedback into a single generation-time fusion pathway, leaving persistent contact states, abrupt contact events, and future contact consequences implicitly modeled in a single representation. We present PACE (Phase-Aware Contact-Event Conditioning), a temporal-role tactile conditioning framework for chunk-based insertion policies. PACE organizes a shared tactile stream into three temporal roles: persistent contact states condition action-chunk generation, abrupt contact events correct the generated chunk, and contact-consequence prediction shapes action representations during training. This design preserves chunk-level action continuity while assigning distinct pathways to different temporal roles of contact feedback. Across five real-robot insertion tasks, PACE achieves an average success rate of 90.7%, outperforming vision-only and generation-time tactile-fusion baselines by over 44 percentage points; on the ManipulationNet benchmark, PACE maintains 88.7% success across six geometry-clearance configurations, including an industrial-grade 0.1-mm clearance. Ablations confirm the complementary contributions of the three temporal roles, mechanistic analyses show that PACE separates normal insertion progress from contact events requiring immediate correction, and cross-signal and cross-architecture experiments indicate that this temporal-role principle extends across different physical feedback signals and policy backbones. Videos and materials are available at https://pace-insertion.github.io/.

摘要（中文）：接触丰富的插入任务要求机器人将视觉对齐与触觉调整相结合。然而，现有的基于触觉-视觉分块（chunk）的策略将触觉反馈压缩为单一的生成时融合路径，使得持续的接触状态、突发的接触事件以及未来的接触后果被隐式地建模在单一表征中。我们提出PACE（Phase-Aware Contact-Event Conditioning，相位感知接触事件条件化），一种面向分块插入策略的时间角色触觉条件化框架。PACE将共享的触觉流组织为三种时间角色：持续接触状态条件化动作分块的生成，突发接触事件修正已生成的分块，接触后果预测在训练阶段塑造动作表征。该设计在保留分块级动作连续性的同时，为接触反馈的不同时间角色分配了独立的路径。在五项真实机器人插入任务中，PACE实现了90.7%的平均成功率，比仅依赖视觉和生成时触觉融合的基线方法高出超过44个百分点；在ManipulationNet基准测试中，PACE在六种几何间隙配置下保持了88.7%的成功率，其中包括工业级的0.1毫米间隙。消融实验证实了三种时间角色的互补贡献，机制分析表明PACE能够区分正常的插入进展与需要立即纠正的接触事件，跨信号和跨架构实验进一步表明，该时间角色原理可推广至不同的物理反馈信号和策略骨干网络。视频和材料可在 https://pace-insertion.github.io/ 获取。

Authors: Zhiyuan Chen, Shixiong Xu, Shuai Chen, Yangwei You

Same Goal, Different Words: Spatial Instruction Sensitivity in World-Action Models Manipulation

world-action models instruction sensitivity spatial relations language grounding RoboLab

简要说明：本文通过864次 rollout 评估了世界动作模型对空间指令的敏感性，发现通过参考对象重述空间目标会降低成功率，且稳定放置率在回合结束时下降，表明需评估模型的一致性、接地性和指令遵循能力。

TLDR: This paper evaluates spatial instruction sensitivity in world-action models across 864 rollouts, finding that rephrasing spatial goals via the reference object reduces success rates, while stable placements decrease by episode end. It motivates evaluating model consistency, grounding, and instruction following.

Abstract: World-action models should preserve the intended manipulation across equivalent descriptions of a spatial goal. We evaluate this consistency in 864 rollouts from three models across four RoboLab scenes, holding initial states and task goals fixed. Describing relations through the reference object rather than the object-to-move lowers the rate of reaching a stable placement by 12.2 percentage points on average. The effect of instruction rephrasing varies across spatial relations, so aggregate scores can hide sensitivity to wording. Standalone tests of the policies' language understanding identify relation reversals and show that adding images can disrupt otherwise correct text-only interpretations. Rollout analysis also distinguishes spatial placement from instruction following: moving the wrong object can satisfy the requested relation, and rates of stable placement fall from 43.2% at any time to 21.8% at episode end. These findings motivate a more thorough evaluation of world-action models' steerability, language understanding, and grounding. Evaluations should test consistency across equivalent instructions, verify that the intended object moved, and check whether the requested arrangement persists to the end of the rollout.

摘要（中文）：世界-动作模型应在对空间目标的不同等效描述之间保持预期的操控一致性。我们在四个RoboLab场景中，对三个模型进行了864次滚动评估，保持初始状态和任务目标不变。通过参考物体而非待移动物体来描述关系时，达到稳定放置位置的平均成功率降低了12.2个百分点。指令改述的影响在不同空间关系中有所差异，因此总体得分可能掩盖对措辞的敏感性。对策略语言理解能力的独立测试识别出关系反转现象，并表明添加图像可能干扰原本正确的纯文本解释。滚动分析还区分了空间放置与指令遵循：移动错误的物体可能满足所要求的关系，而稳定放置率从任意时刻的43.2%降至回合结束时的21.8%。这些发现促使我们对世界-动作模型的可引导性、语言理解能力和 grounding 进行更全面的评估。评估应测试跨等效指令的一致性，验证预期物体是否被移动，并检查所要求的排列是否持续到滚动结束。

Authors: Ali-Adeeb Abbas, Esmaeil Seraj, Behrad Toghi, Taskin Padir

Directional Pullback Regularization for Long-Horizon Rollout of Latent World Models in Autonomous Driving WorldModel

latent world models non-holonomic constraints directional pullback regularization autonomous driving long-horizon rollout

简要说明：本文提出方向拉回正则化（DPR），一种在训练时通过解码器雅可比矩阵将运动学感知的各向异性黎曼度量拉回潜在空间的方法，提升了自动驾驶世界模型长时程开环自车运动预测的准确性。

TLDR: The paper introduces Directional Pullback Regularization (DPR), a training-time method that enforces kinematics-aware geometry in the latent space of world models for autonomous driving, improving long-horizon open-loop ego-motion rollout accuracy by penalizing lateral motion directions.

Abstract: Learned world models for autonomous driving operate in unconstrained latent spaces, yet the physical systems they represent are governed by strict non-holonomic constraints: ground vehicles cannot realize instantaneous pure lateral motion. We study long-horizon latent rollout modeling for autonomous driving and ask whether rollout quality can be improved by assigning a motion-aware geometry to latent transitions, rather than by redesigning the predictor architecture. Starting from an unconstrained latent rollout baseline, we introduce Directional Pullback Regularization (DPR), a training time method that defines a kinematics-aware anisotropic Riemannian metric in decoded state space and pulls it back through the decoder Jacobian to the latent manifold. The resulting latent-space metric assigns higher cost to latent directions that decode to lateral vehicle motion, while preserving the original encoder-dynamics-decoder backbone. This yields a clean three-way comparison among an Unconstrained Latent Rollout model (ULR), an Euclidean Pullback Regularization ablation (EPR), and the full directional method (DPR). We evaluate all models on open-loop ego-motion rollout over a common 10-second test horizon, using training rollout lengths of 1, 3, 5, and 10 steps. Across all four training regimes, DPR achieves lower 10-second final displacement error than both ULR and EPR. The strongest relative accuracy gain appears for models trained with 3-step rollout supervision, where DPR reduces the 10-second final displacement error by approximately 44 percent relative to ULR. The strongest overall control-relevant tradeoff is obtained for longer rollout-trained models, especially at 10 steps, where DPR simultaneously improves displacement error, lateral motion consistency, and forward motion preservation relative to both ULR and EPR.

摘要（中文）：学习型自动驾驶世界模型在无约束的潜空间中运行，然而其所表征的物理系统受严格的非完整约束支配：地面车辆无法实现瞬时的纯横向运动。本文研究面向自动驾驶的长时程潜空间展开建模，探讨是否可以通过为潜空间状态转移赋予具有运动学感知的几何结构来提升展开质量，而非重新设计预测器架构。我们从无约束的潜空间展开基线出发，提出方向拉回正则化（DPR）方法——一种训练期方法，在解码状态空间中定义具有运动学感知的各向异性黎曼度量，并通过解码器雅可比矩阵将其拉回至潜流形。由此产生的潜空间度量对解码为车辆横向运动的潜方向赋予更高代价，同时保留原有的编码器-动力学-解码器主干结构。这构成了三种方法的清晰对比：无约束潜空间展开模型（ULR）、欧几里得拉回正则化消融模型（EPR）以及完整的方向性方法（DPR）。我们在统一的10秒测试时域上对所有模型进行开环自车运动展开评估，并采用1、3、5和10步的训练展开长度。在所有四种训练机制下，DPR均取得比ULR和EPR更低的10秒最终位移误差。最强的相对精度提升出现在以3步展开监督训练的模型中，此时DPR相对于ULR将10秒最终位移误差降低了约44%。总体最优的控制相关权衡则出现在更长展开训练的模型中，尤其是在10步设置下，DPR相对于ULR和EPR同时改善了位移误差、横向运动一致性和前向运动保持能力。

Authors: Shatadal Mishra, Ahmadreza Moradipari, Nejib Ammar

PathLift: Depth-Conditioned Metric Lifting for Visual-Navigation Priors VLN

visual navigation depth-conditioned adapter metric path lifting closed-loop navigation RGB-D/stereo/LiDAR

简要说明：PathLift 是一种深度条件适配器，利用传感器深度将视觉导航先验从无量纲意图提升为度量的逐路点路径，在真实机器人上无需测试时优化即可提高闭环导航成功率。

TLDR: PathLift is a depth-conditioned adapter that lifts unitless visual-navigation priors into metric, per-waypoint paths using explicit sensor depth, improving closed-loop navigation on real robots without test-time optimization.

Abstract: Generalist visual-navigation policies tell a robot which direction to go but not how far. A separate lifting step is needed at deployment to convert their unitless trajectory into a metric path that a controller can track; existing scalar lifters apply uniform scaling that misses per-waypoint corrections, while in-policy approaches that inject monocular depth into the policy inherit the prediction errors of the depth model near obstacles and at close range. We present PathLift, a per-waypoint depth-conditioned adapter that lifts a pre-trained visual-navigation policy by consuming an explicit, sensor-grade depth source (RGB-D, stereo, or projected LiDAR) and fitting per-waypoint magnitude and lateral residuals to a canonicalized prior. PathLift consistently improves closed-loop navigation across diverse visual-navigation policies in simulation and on a real wheeled robot under both stereo and LiDAR depth. By turning the policy's unitless intent into a depth-feasible metric path in a single feed-forward pass, the adapter lifts real-world success without test-time optimization.

摘要（中文）：通用视觉导航策略能够告知机器人行进方向，但无法指示行进距离。部署时需要额外的提升步骤，将其无量纲轨迹转换为控制器可跟踪的度量路径；现有的标量提升器采用均匀缩放，忽略了逐路点修正，而将单目深度注入策略的策略内方法则在障碍物附近及近距离范围内继承了深度模型的预测误差。 我们提出PathLift，一种逐路点深度条件适配器，通过消费显式的、传感器级深度源（RGB-D、立体视觉或投影激光雷达）并拟合逐路点幅度与横向残差至规范化先验，从而提升预训练的视觉导航策略。PathLift在仿真及真实轮式机器人上，在立体视觉与激光雷达深度条件下，一致性地提升了多种视觉导航策略的闭环导航性能。通过单次前向传播将策略的无量纲意图转化为深度可行的度量路径，该适配器在无需测试时优化的前提下提升了真实世界的成功率。
