Authors: Gwanjun Shin, Hyeongseok Suh, Hongmo Jung, Jongwoo Lim

P-BFM: Perceptive Behavioral Foundation Models for Humanoid Control via Unsupervised Reinforcement Learning HumanoidEmbodied

behavioral foundation models humanoid control unsupervised reinforcement learning terrain-conditioned realization perceptive policy

简要说明：P-BFM通过无监督强化学习将人形机器人控制分解为与地形无关的行为意图和依赖地形条件的实现，使单个冻结策略能够执行运动跟踪、目标到达、奖励推断、遥操作和扰动恢复，并零样本迁移到Unitree G1机器人。

TLDR: P-BFM factorizes humanoid control into terrain-invariant behavioral intent and terrain-conditioned realization via unsupervised reinforcement learning, enabling a single frozen policy to track motions, reach goals, infer rewards, teleoperate, and recover from perturbations with zero-shot transfer to a Unitree G1 robot.

Abstract: Behavioral foundation models (BFMs) provide humanoids with reusable repertoires of whole-body behaviors; in real-world humanoid control, the same behavioral intent may require fundamentally different motions under different terrain constraints. Covering such variation with terrain-matched demonstrations requires enumerating a combinatorial space of behaviors and terrain geometries. We introduce P-BFM, a perceptive behavioral foundation model that factorizes humanoid control into terrain-invariant intent and terrain-conditioned realization. A forward-backward representation maps motion references, target states, and reward functions into a shared intent space without terrain information, while a perceptive policy learns how to realize each intent under the surrounding terrain geometry. We further identify a complementary limitation of purely latent control: behavioral latents can preserve local motion patterns while losing precise global progress. We therefore introduce Explicit Root Instructions (ERI), which separates global transport (e.g., heading and planar velocity) from behavioral intent, while leaving local whole-body adaptation to the perceptive policy. This decomposition leads to a characteristic capability absent from conventional BFMs: one fixed intent induces different, terrain-appropriate behaviors, including changes in step height, stride, posture, foothold placement, and contacts, without terrain-specific demonstrations. Across challenging terrains, P-BFM improves motion fidelity, root-control precision, and perturbation recovery over strong baselines. A single frozen policy further supports motion tracking, goal reaching, reward inference, teleoperation, and terrain-aware recovery, and transfers zero-shot to a Unitree G1 using onboard depth sensing.

摘要（中文）：行为基础模型（BFMs）为仿人机器人提供了可复用的全身行为库；在真实世界的人形机器人控制中，相同的行为意图在不同地形约束下可能要求本质上不同的运动模式。为覆盖此类变化，若依赖与地形匹配的示范数据，则需要枚举行为与地形几何的组合空间。我们提出P-BFM，一种感知型行为基础模型，将人形机器人控制分解为地形不变意图与地形条件化实现两部分。前向-反向表示将运动参考、目标状态和奖励函数映射到不包含地形信息的共享意图空间，而感知策略则学习如何在地形几何约束下实现每种意图。我们进一步识别出纯隐式控制的一个互补性局限：行为潜变量能够保留局部运动模式，却可能丢失精确的全局进展。为此，我们引入显式根部指令（ERI），将全局位移（如朝向和平面速度）与行为意图分离，同时将局部全身自适应交给感知策略处理。这一分解带来传统BFM所不具备的独特能力：一个固定意图可诱发多种与地形相适应的行为，包括步高、步幅、姿态、落脚点及接触模式的变化，而无需地形特异的示范数据。在挑战性地形上，P-BFM在运动保真度、根部控制精度和扰动恢复方面均优于强基线方法。单个冻结策略即可支持运动跟踪、目标到达、奖励推断、遥操作和地形感知恢复，并可通过板载深度感知零样本迁移至Unitree G1平台。

Authors: Xue Wang, Yitang Li, Yiming Zhang, Siqin Wang, Junhan Sun, Zhihao Liu, Yaojie Shen, Jingbo Yuan, Hao Zhao, Qingdu Li

ReTrace: Cross-Stage Failure Attribution for Self-Improving Robotic Manipulation Manipulation

self-improvement failure attribution cross-stage dependencies manipulation reusable skills

简要说明：ReTrace 是一个机器人操作自我改进框架，通过自主交互将跨阶段失败追溯到早期决策，提出并验证修正方案，最终整合为可复用技能，在无需演示或模型更新的情况下显著提升真实任务成功率。

TLDR: ReTrace is a self-improvement framework for robotic manipulation that autonomously learns from failures by tracing cross-stage errors back to earlier decisions, proposing and validating corrections through physical interaction, and consolidating them into reusable skills, achieving dramatic success-rate gains on real-world tasks without demonstrations or model updates.

Abstract: General-purpose multimodal foundation models are increasingly capable of directly controlling robots, yet improving their manipulation capabilities through autonomous interaction remains challenging. A key challenge to such self-improvement is learning from failures in complex manipulation tasks involving cross-stage dependencies, where an action may succeed locally but cause a later stage to fail. To address this challenge, we introduce ReTrace, a self-improvement framework for robotic manipulation through autonomous physical interaction and retrospective reasoning, without provided demonstrations or model-parameter updates. ReTrace retrospectively traces downstream failures to earlier decisions, proposes targeted corrections, and evaluates them through subsequent interactions. Across attempts, ReTrace progressively consolidates validated corrections into a reusable manipulation skill that guide subsequent execution. We evaluate ReTrace on four real-world manipulation tasks using a Franka Research 3 robot. On the two tasks with strong cross-stage dependencies, GPT-6 Astra-low improves from 0% to 80% success on plug insertion and from 0% to 100% on ball pouring, while GPT-6 Sol-xhigh improves from 0% to 10% and 0% to 90%, respectively. The learned skills also transfer across model and reasoning configurations and reduce inference-time decision cost in most evaluated settings.

摘要（中文）：通用多模态基础模型在直接控制机器人方面能力日益增强，但通过自主交互来提升其操作技能仍具挑战性。此类自我改进的关键难点在于，在涉及跨阶段依赖的复杂操作任务中从失败中学习——即某个动作可能在局部取得成功，却导致后续阶段失败。为解决这一问题，我们提出ReTrace，一个通过自主物理交互与回溯推理实现机器人操作自我改进的框架，无需提供示范或更新模型参数。ReTrace将下游失败回溯追踪至早期决策，提出针对性修正，并通过后续交互对其进行评估。在多次尝试过程中，ReTrace逐步将验证有效的修正整合为可复用的操作技能，用以指导后续执行。我们使用Franka Research 3机器人在四项真实世界操作任务上对ReTrace进行了评估。在两项具有强跨阶段依赖的任务中，GPT-6 Astra-low在插头插入任务上成功率从0%提升至80%，在倒球任务上从0%提升至100%；而GPT-6 Sol-xhigh在这两项任务上的成功率分别从0%提升至10%和从0%提升至90%。所学技能还可跨模型及推理配置迁移，并在大多数评估场景中降低了推理阶段的决策成本。

Authors: Yue Yu, Bin Zhu, Junhui Li, Jiayu Wang, Shijie Zhou, Jingjing Chen

LIBERO-Industry: Benchmarking Robotic Manipulation under Industrial Process Constraints Manipulation

benchmark robotic manipulation industrial constraints generalist policies LIBERO

简要说明：LIBERO-Industry 是一个新的机器人操作基准，它将工业过程约束系统地引入 LIBERO 框架，并评估通用机器人策略在这些约束下的表现。

TLDR: LIBERO-Industry is a new benchmark for robotic manipulation that systematically introduces industrial process constraints into the LIBERO framework, and evaluates generalist robot policies under these constraints.

Abstract: Industrial manipulation in flexible manufacturing, e.g., high-mix, low-volume (HMLV) electronics assembly, requires robot policies to adapt to changing products and production conditions. Such settings impose industrial process constraints, including product variants, moving material flows, finite execution windows, and tight geometric tolerances. However, existing evaluation frameworks do not systematically capture these constraints when assessing generalist robot policies. To address this gap, we introduce LIBERO-Industry, a novel benchmark built on the widely used robot learning benchmark LIBERO, that translates the aforementioned industrial constraints into controllable task conditions and measurable success criteria. Specifically, LIBERO-Industry comprises three classic task scenarios: Static-to-Dynamic (S2D) loading, Dynamic-to-Static (D2S) unloading, and Dynamic-to-Dynamic (D2D) transfer. The suites contain 216 tasks in total that systematically vary object geometry, conveyor speed, interaction-window duration, and geometric acceptance region size. Extensive experiments across five generalist robot policies (including vision-language-action models and world-action models) show that performance progressively degrades as industrial constraints are introduced and combined. Under a shared fine-tuning and evaluation protocol, the LIBERO-Industry co-training condition achieved higher observed target-transfer completion than the original-LIBERO condition.

摘要（中文）：工业柔性制造中的操作任务（例如高混合、低产量（HMLV）的电子组装）要求机器人策略能够适应不断变化的产品和生产条件。此类场景施加了工业过程约束，包括产品变体、移动物料流、有限执行窗口以及严格的几何公差。然而，现有的评估框架在评估通用机器人策略时并未系统性地涵盖这些约束。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了LIBERO-Industry，一个基于广泛使用的机器人学习基准LIBERO构建的新基准，将上述工业约束转化为可控的任务条件和可量化的成功标准。具体而言，LIBERO-Industry包含三个经典任务场景：静态到动态（S2D）装载、动态到静态（D2S）卸载以及动态到动态（D2D）转移。该套件共包含216个任务，系统性地变化了物体几何形状、传送带速度、交互窗口持续时间和几何接受区域大小。对五种通用机器人策略（包括视觉-语言-动作模型和世界-动作模型）的大量实验表明，随着工业约束的引入和组合，性能逐渐下降。在共享的微调和评估协议下，LIBERO-Industry的联合训练条件相较于原始LIBERO条件，实现了更高的观测目标转移完成率。

Authors: Ming Shin Cindy Sung, Duan Leijiahao, Haoxiang Wang, Boning Tan, Liangna Fu, Chao Tan, Yafu Li, Yulong Chen, Chaoqun Wan, Zhen Huang, Shuxian Liang, Xian-Sheng Hua

RAP-WAM: Learning World-Action Models through Predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations Manipulation

world action model predictive rehearsal action perturbations credit assignment video generation priors

简要说明：RAP-WAM通过预测性排练和动作扰动，学习世界动作模型，利用基于动作响应的时空信用分配来分配视觉监督，在真实机器人任务中取得了高成功率。

TLDR: RAP-WAM introduces a world-action model that learns from video generation priors using predictive rehearsal and action perturbations, allocating visual supervision via action-response-based credit assignment, achieving strong real-robot success rates.

Abstract: Recent world action models draw on video generation priors to jointly predict future observations and robot actions. Adapting these priors to control requires determining how future predictions should guide policy learning. RAP-WAM combines predictive Rehearsal and Action Perturbations (RAP) with future-supervised queries and Coupled Action Projection for policy learning. Predictive rehearsal trains on model-generated inputs while retaining recorded targets, and accumulates recurring errors into a spatial prior. We perturb actions and measure changes in video predictions. Action-response-based spatiotemporal credit assignment combines these responses, prediction error, and the rehearsal prior to allocate visual supervision; spatially aggregating the responses determines supervision intensity across future action steps. No separate scoring network or deployment-time probe is required. The base learns from a video-pretrained backbone without intermediate pretraining on external embodied data. We evaluate the fixed base and its agent-refined, task-conditioned system. On 42 RoboDojo tasks, their average success rates are 12.85% and 15.62%, with Scores of 17.86 and 20.59. Across 15 real-robot tasks, the complete system achieves 89.00% task-macro-average success, exceeding the strongest of five baselines by 37.67 percentage points. Across 315 fixed-output simulation windows, 45.21% of response-top20 positions fall outside error-top20, revealing information beyond prediction error.

摘要（中文）：近期世界行动模型利用视频生成先验知识，联合预测未来观测与机器人动作。将这些先验知识应用于控制，需要确定未来预测应如何引导策略学习。RAP-WAM结合了预测性排练与动作扰动（RAP）、未来监督查询及耦合动作投影，用于策略学习。预测性排练在保留记录目标的同时，基于模型生成的输入进行训练，并将反复出现的误差累积为空间先验。我们对动作施加扰动，并测量视频预测的变化。基于动作响应的时空信用分配综合这些响应、预测误差及排练先验，以分配视觉监督；对响应进行空间聚合，确定未来动作步骤上的监督强度。该方法无需独立的评分网络或部署时探测。基础模型从视频预训练骨干网络学习，无需在外部具身数据上进行中间预训练。我们对固定基础模型及其经智能体精化、任务条件化的系统进行了评估。在42个RoboDojo任务中，它们的平均成功率分别为12.85%和15.62%，得分分别为17.86和20.59。在15个真实机器人任务中，完整系统实现了89.00%的任务宏平均成功率，比五个基线中最强者高出37.67个百分点。在315个固定输出模拟窗口中，45.21%的响应前20位置落在误差前20之外，揭示了超出预测误差之外的信息。

Authors: Yuanpeng He, Ceyao Zhang, Fangjing Li, Kefei Zhu, Lijian Li, Yueheng Li, Tianjia He, Wenpin Jiao, Zhi Jin, Yaodong Yang, Yuanpei Chen

Mining Cross-Modal Perception Gaps in Autonomous Driving: When Camera and LiDAR Disagree AutonomousDriving

multi-modal fusion 3D object detection Shapley attribution reliability map autonomous driving

简要说明：本文挖掘自动驾驶数据中的跨模态感知差异，揭示相机-激光雷达融合假设不成立，并引入模态可靠性图，通过少量微调将预训练融合检测器的mAP提升最高1.3。

TLDR: This paper mines cross-modal perception gaps in autonomous driving datasets, revealing that camera-LiDAR fusion assumptions are violated, and introduces a Modality Reliability Map that improves pretrained fusion detectors by up to 1.3 mAP with minimal fine-tuning.

Abstract: Multi-modal fusion for 3D object detection assumes that cameras and LiDAR are broadly complementary. In practice, how much each modality is trusted at a given location is decided by learned weights that are neither characterized nor auditable. We label every ground-truth object by which modalities detected it, then mine the resulting 0.4M-object database across nuScenes, KITTI, and Waymo. Because the patterns shift with distance from the ego vehicle, we read the mined model through Spatially Stratified Feature Attribution (SSFA), which conditions Shapley attribution on distance zones and exposes structure that global attribution averages away. Three assumptions built into the current fusion design do not hold. The modality-preference boundary tracks the object itself: a traffic cone is nearly six times as likely as a truck to be seen by the camera alone (16.8% vs. 2.9%), regardless of range. Camera-only detections peak at 10-30 m, inside the band usually ceded to LiDAR, and fall away on either side. The drivers of failure are not additive either: the distance - density interaction alone outweighs the entire main effect of viewing direction. We further find that modality dominance is directionally non-stationary, with objects behind the vehicle being markedly more LiDAR-dominant than those in front. We compile the mined structure into a Modality Reliability Map and inject it into four pretrained fusion detectors through a lightweight attention layer. This improves performance by up to 1.3 mean Average Precision (mAP) while fine-tuning under 4% of their parameters in 2-3 GPU-hours. Our work lifts reliability out of the weights and treats it as a quantity that can be examined before deployment. That is what a safety measure for multi-modal perception must rest on.

摘要（中文）：多模态融合的3D目标检测方法假定相机与激光雷达在功能上具有广泛的互补性。然而在实际应用中，每个模态在特定位置上的受信任程度是由学习得到的权重决定的，这些权重既缺乏可解释性，也不具备可审计性。我们对每一个真实目标标注出由哪些模态检测到，并在此基础上挖掘了跨越nuScenes、KITTI和Waymo数据集的约40万目标数据库。由于模态偏好模式随自车距离的变化而变化，我们通过空间分层特征归因方法（SSFA）来解读挖掘出的模型。该方法将Shapley归因按距离区间进行条件化处理，揭示出全局归因平均化所掩盖的结构性信息。研究发现，当前融合设计中内置的三项假设均不成立。模态偏好边界随目标类别而变化：交通锥被相机单独检测到的概率是卡车的近六倍（16.8%对2.9%），且这一比例不受距离影响。相机单独检测的峰值出现在10至30米区间，恰好位于通常划归激光雷达优势的区域内，且向两侧逐渐衰减。失效驱动因素也并非加性关系——距离与点云密度的交互效应单独就超过了视角方向的全部主效应。此外，我们发现模态主导性在方向上具有非平稳性，车辆后方目标比前方目标显著更倾向于由激光雷达主导。我们将挖掘出的结构信息整合为模态可靠性图谱，并通过一个轻量级注意力层将其注入四个预训练的融合检测器中。在仅微调不到4%的参数、耗时2至3个GPU小时的情况下，该方法将平均精度（mAP）最多提升了1.3个点。本研究将可靠性从网络权重中剥离出来，使其成为部署前可被检验的量化指标。这正是多模态感知安全度量所必须依赖的基础。

Authors: Hongsen Cao, Mona Jaber, Shanxin Yuan, Ahmed Sayed

RAR: Rate-Adaptive Rollout for Time-Consistent Interactive World Models WorldModel

temporal-rate coupling Stride-RoPE multi-stride video sampling online rate switching interactive world models

简要说明：RAR 通过 Stride-RoPE 和多步长训练，使交互式世界模型能够以可控的时间速率生成时间一致的视频，支持在线速率切换和扩展物理视野。

TLDR: RAR introduces Rate-Adaptive Rollout with Stride-RoPE and multi-stride training to enable interactive world models to generate temporally consistent video at controllable rates, supporting online rate switching and extended physical horizons.

Abstract: Video-based interactive world models aim to enable real-time, user-controllable environments. Yet most existing systems are trained and rolled out at a fixed temporal rate, limiting both runtime-rate adaptation and physical-horizon coverage -- a limitation we term temporal-rate coupling. Specifically, when runtime generation throughput differs from the learned temporal rate, the generated world evolves unintentionally more slowly or quickly. Moreover, using a single temporal rate imposes an inherent trade-off between temporal granularity and physical horizon: higher rates capture finer motion but cover a shorter duration under a fixed context window. To address both limitations, we introduce Rate-Adaptive Rollout (RAR), a framework that enables interactive world models to roll out at controllable temporal rates. At its core, Stride-RoPE aligns latent frames sampled at different rates on a shared physical-time coordinate, enabling consistent multi-rate rollout, unseen-rate generalization, and online rate switching without discarding history. Meanwhile, RAR uses multi-stride video sampling to enable joint learning of fine-grained dynamics and long-horizon evolution. Across action- and camera-controlled environments, RAR achieves temporally consistent multi-rate rollout and online rate switching while preserving high-rate generation quality and extending physical horizons under matched training budgets. RAR also transfers to pretrained world models while preserving perceptual quality.

摘要（中文）：基于视频的交互式世界模型旨在实现实时、用户可控的环境。然而，现有的大多数系统在固定的时间速率下进行训练和部署，这限制了运行速率的自适应以及物理时域的覆盖范围——我们将这一局限性称为时间速率耦合。具体而言，当运行时生成吞吐量与学习到的时间速率不一致时，所生成的世界会无意中演化得较慢或较快。此外，使用单一时间速率在时间粒度和物理时域之间存在固有取舍：较高速率能捕捉更精细的运动，但在固定上下文窗口下覆盖的时长较短。为解决这两个局限性，我们引入了速率自适应展开（RAR）框架，该框架使交互式世界模型能够以可控的时间速率进行展开。其核心创新Stride-RoPE将不同速率下采样的潜在帧对齐到共享的物理时间坐标上，从而支持一致的多速率展开、未见速率的泛化以及在线速率切换，且无需丢弃历史信息。同时，RAR采用多步长视频采样，以联合学习细粒度动力学与长时域演化。在动作控制和相机控制的环境中，RAR实现了时间上一致的多速率展开和在线速率切换，同时在匹配的训练预算下保持了高速率生成质量并扩展了物理时域。RAR还可迁移至预训练的世界模型，同时保持感知质量。

Authors: Yaoyang Liu, Dongyu Yan, Yihua Du, Shengju Qian, Zeke Xie, Xin Wang, Ying-Cong Chen, Long Chen

Adversarial Robustness of Camera-Radar Sensor Fusion for Autonomous Driving AutonomousDriving

adversarial robustness camera-radar fusion 3D object detection depth estimation nuScenes

简要说明：本文系统研究了自动驾驶中相机-雷达融合的对抗鲁棒性，发现相机扰动导致严重性能下降而雷达扰动影响有限，并提出了更鲁棒融合的设计启示。

TLDR: This paper systematically studies the adversarial robustness of camera-radar fusion in autonomous driving, revealing that camera perturbations cause severe degradation while radar perturbations have limited impact, and proposes design implications for more robust fusion.

Abstract: Autonomous driving (AD) relies on multi-sensor perception to interpret the surrounding environment. However, the robustness of camera--radar fusion under adversarial conditions remains largely unexplored. This paper presents a systematic measurement study of the robustness of camera--radar sensor fusion in AD. We construct a unified evaluation pipeline on the nuScenes dataset that simulates attacks on both sensing modalities, including eight camera-image perturbations and three radar point-cloud perturbations. We evaluate five camera--radar fusion algorithms across two perception tasks, 3D object detection and depth estimation, and quantify their performance under clean and attacked inputs using standard metrics. Our evaluation reveals a clear asymmetry in the robustness of fusion systems. Camera perturbations substantially degrade both object detection and depth estimation, and moderate attack strengths are already sufficient to cause severe performance degradation. In contrast, the evaluated radar perturbations produce smaller and task-dependent effects, with object-detection models showing particularly limited degradation. Our analysis attributes this difference to the strong dependence of existing fusion architectures on dense camera features, together with the filtering, association, and confidence-weighting mechanisms commonly applied to sparse radar measurements. These results demonstrate that sensor fusion does not inherently guarantee robustness and that the contribution and reliability of each sensing modality must be explicitly considered under adversarial conditions. Based on four empirical findings, we derive measurement-guided design implications for future robust camera--radar fusion, including modality-specific reliability estimation, cross-modal consistency checking, adaptive fusion, and graceful failover under severe sensor degradation.

摘要（中文）：自动驾驶（AD）依赖多传感器感知来解释周围环境。然而，相机-雷达融合在对抗条件下的鲁棒性在很大程度上仍未得到充分探索。本文对自动驾驶中相机-雷达传感器融合的鲁棒性进行了系统性测量研究。我们在nuScenes数据集上构建了一个统一的评估流水线，该流水线模拟对两种感知模态的攻击，包括八种相机图像扰动和三种雷达点云扰动。我们评估了五种相机-雷达融合算法在两项感知任务（3D目标检测和深度估计）上的表现，并使用标准指标量化了它们在干净输入和受攻击输入下的性能。我们的评估揭示了融合系统鲁棒性中明显的非对称性。相机扰动显著降低了目标检测和深度估计的性能，且中等强度的攻击已足以导致严重的性能退化。相比之下，所评估的雷达扰动产生的影响较小且依赖于具体任务，其中目标检测模型表现出尤为有限的退化。我们的分析将这种差异归因于现有融合架构对密集相机特征的强依赖性，以及通常应用于稀疏雷达测量的滤波、关联和置信度加权机制。这些结果表明，传感器融合并不固有地保证鲁棒性，且在对抗条件下必须明确考虑每种感知模态的贡献和可靠性。基于四项实证发现，我们得出了面向测量的设计启示，以指导未来鲁棒的相机-雷达融合，包括模态特定的可靠性估计、跨模态一致性检查、自适应融合以及在严重传感器退化下的优雅故障切换。

Authors: Ce Zhou, Yubo Wu, Khang Nguyen, Liyang Xiao, Thomas Hou, Qiben Yan

Interactive Navigation Beyond Reachability: Benchmark and Agentic Framework VLN

interactive navigation benchmark vision-language model agentic framework interaction graph

简要说明：本文提出了 MultINav-Bench 基准，用于评估需要开门和开容器才能到达目标的交互式导航任务；并提出了 MultINav-Agent 框架，利用视觉语言模型和持久化的交互图，在该基准上取得了最佳性能。

TLDR: The paper introduces MultINav-Bench, a benchmark for interactive navigation beyond reachability where agents must open doors and containers, and MultINav-Agent, a vision-language-model-driven framework with a persistent interaction graph that achieves state-of-the-art results on the benchmark.

Abstract: Existing embodied navigation tasks commonly assume that traversability and object states remain fixed during an episode. Yet reaching a goal may require opening a door to access a room and then opening a container to reveal a hidden target. We formulate interactive navigation beyond reachability, unifying channel-induced changes in spatial connectivity, container-induced changes in target visibility, and their sequential dependencies. We introduce MultINav-Bench, a 3K-episode ObjectGoal benchmark in MolmoSpaces spanning channel, container, and mixed tasks, with interaction-necessity annotations covering required and unnecessary episodes. Its data generation pipeline automates task construction across multiple task types. The evaluation protocol separately measures navigation success, interaction effectiveness, and cost. We further propose MultINav-Agent, a three-stage agentic framework built on a persistent, state-conditioned interaction graph. Semantic interactive perception grounds entities and interaction states; a vision-language model selects task-relevant actions based on expected changes in connectivity and target observability; and post-interaction verification updates the graph to guide subsequent navigation, exploration, or interaction. Experiments on MultINav-Bench show that MultINav-Agent consistently outperforms adapted baselines across channel, container, and mixed tasks.

摘要（中文）：现有的具身导航任务通常假设在一个回合中，可穿越性和物体状态保持不变。然而，达到目标可能需要打开门进入房间，再打开容器以发现隐藏的目标。我们提出了超越可达性的交互式导航，统一了通道引发的空间连通性变化、容器引发的目标可见性变化及其序列依赖关系。我们引入了MultINav-Bench，这是一个在MolmoSpaces中涵盖通道、容器及混合任务的3K情节ObjectGoal基准，并带有交互必要性标注，涵盖必需与不必要的情节。其数据生成流水线可在多种任务类型间自动化构建任务。评估协议分别衡量导航成功率、交互有效性和成本。我们进一步提出了MultINav-Agent，这是一个基于持久化、状态条件交互图的三阶段智能体框架。语义交互感知对实体及交互状态进行识别；视觉-语言模型基于连通性和目标可观测性的预期变化选择任务相关动作；交互后验证更新交互图以指导后续的导航、探索或交互。在MultINav-Bench上的实验表明，MultINav-Agent在通道、容器和混合任务中始终优于适配的基线方法。

Authors: Delun Li, Xueyao Wei, Rui Chen, Yifei Wang, Junzhi Yu, Wenjie Song, Xingyu Chen

Observe, Share, or Predict? Disentangling Partner Information in Embodied Multi-Agent Collaboration Other

embodied multi-agent collaboration LLM agents partial observability partner modeling Habitat PARTNR

简要说明：本文研究基于LLM的具身智能体能否通过观察同伴状态、共享物体知识或预测同伴下一步行动来进行协作，使用Habitat中的PARTNR基准。他们发现观察和知识交换能提高效率，而行动预测则大多有害，表明同伴建模较浅。

TLDR: This paper investigates whether LLM-based embodied agents can collaborate by observing a partner's state, sharing object knowledge, or predicting the partner's next action, using the PARTNR benchmark in Habitat. They find that observation and knowledge exchange improve efficiency, while action prediction is largely detrimental, revealing shallow partner modeling.

Abstract: LLMs are used as high-level controllers for embodied agents, but it remains unclear whether they support collaborative reasoning, such as anticipating a collaborator's actions in real-time teamwork without dialogue. We ask if observing the partner's state, exchanging object knowledge, and predicting the partner's next action, shape task outcomes and coordination when agents can share percepts but never intentions, plans, or task-level messages, and whether the two agents occupy symmetric roles. Using the Habitat-based PARTNR benchmark, we introduce a Decoupled Partial Observability regime that enforces strictly individual perception, and we augment decentralized zero-shot ReAct planners with Other Agent's State (OAS) observation, object Knowledge Exchange (KE) between co-located agents, and Other Agent's Next Action (OANA) prediction, evaluated on the full 2 x 2 x 2 grid with four planners on 1,000 validation tasks. OAS observation improves task quality, reducing extraneous effort for every planner, whereas KE primarily improves execution efficiency, cutting simulation steps by up to 25% with little change in success. The two are largely redundant for strong planners but complementary for the weakest, for which KE without the OAS is the worst configuration. OANA prediction lowers the success rate in 15 of 16 model x context pairs while raising explicit partner mentions to 55-100%, and its accuracy gains lie mainly in the coarse action type, partly because agents recognize the action the partner is already performing. The robot retrieves objects sooner and completes its tasks earlier than the simulated human. Shared context reduces total task time by shortening the remaining duration that the human works alone. Also, coordination benefits arise from responding to shared context, especially the OAS, rather than explicit anticipation, yielding shallow, planner-dependent partner modeling.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）被用作具身智能体的高层控制器，但它们是否支持协作推理——例如在无对话的实时团队协作中预判队友的行动——仍不明确。我们探究以下问题：当智能体能够共享感知信息，但无法共享意图、计划或任务级消息时，观察队友状态、交换物体知识以及预测队友下一步行动是否会影响任务结果与协调效果，以及两个智能体是否扮演对称角色。基于以Habitat为基础的PARTNR基准，我们引入了一种解耦的部分可观测机制，以强制实现严格独立的个体感知，并利用其他智能体状态（OAS）观测、共处智能体之间的物体知识交换（KE）以及其他智能体下一步行动（OANA）预测，增强去中心化的零样本ReAct规划器，在完整的2×2×2网格上使用四种规划器在1,000个验证任务中进行评估。OAS观测提升了任务质量，减少了每个规划器的多余操作；而KE主要提高了执行效率，将模拟步数最多减少25%，但成功率变化不大。对于较强的规划器而言，两者在很大程度上是冗余的；但对于最弱的规划器，两者具有互补性，其中无OAS的KE配置表现最差。OANA预测在16个模型×上下文组合中有15个降低了成功率，同时将明确的队友提及率提升至55%至100%，且其准确性提升主要集中于粗略的动作类型，部分原因在于智能体识别的是队友正在执行的当前动作。机器人在物体获取和任务完成时间上均早于模拟人类。共享上下文通过缩短人类独自工作的剩余时长，减少了总任务时间。此外，协调收益源于对共享上下文——尤其是OAS——的响应，而非明确的预判机制，由此形成了较为浅层且依赖具体规划器的队友建模方式。

Authors: Adrián Szlatincsán, Filippo Ziliotto, Bruno Lepri, Luciano Serafini, Massimiliano Luca, Tommaso Campari

DR-APO: Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization from Continuous Control to Embodied Navigation RLRobot

policy optimization diffusion policies flow-matching policies embodied navigation

简要说明：DR-APO 提出了一种与策略表示无关的优化方法，适用于高斯、扩散和流策略，并在连续控制和具身导航任务中提升了性能，包括真实世界的部署。

TLDR: DR-APO introduces a representation-agnostic policy optimization method that works across Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies, improving performance in continuous control and embodied navigation tasks, including real-world deployment.

Abstract: Policy representations in reinforcement learning have expanded beyond Gaussian policies to diffusion and flow-matching based generative policies. However, existing RL methods remain representation-specific, lacking a unified optimization interface for emerging generative policies. In particular, extending likelihood-based objectives to multi-step generative policies couples optimization to their internal generation process, where accumulated likelihood ratios can weaken the update signal. Meanwhile, generative-policy-specific methods often rely on multi-candidate generation and critic-based selection, improving overall return while providing limited improvement to the policy itself. We introduce DR-APO (Decoupled-Representation Advantage-Guided Policy Optimization), which decouples policy improvement from policy representation through advantage-guided target improvement and representation-compatible direct action fitting, providing a shared optimization principle for Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies. Across five MuJoCo-v5 tasks, DR-APO remains competitive with SAC for Gaussian policies and achieves the best aggregate policy-only performance for both diffusion and flow-matching policies. NavDP post-training improves the Success Rate (SR) from 70.33% to 89.55% in simulation and from 25% to 65% in real-world navigation. These results demonstrate a unified policy-improvement principle across Gaussian, diffusion, and flow policies, from continuous-control learning to embodied-policy post-training.

摘要（中文）：强化学习中的策略表示已从高斯策略扩展至基于扩散和流匹配的生成式策略。然而，现有的强化学习方法仍局限于特定表示形式，缺乏面向新兴生成式策略的统一优化接口。具体而言，将基于似然的目标扩展到多步生成式策略时，优化过程与其内部生成过程耦合，累积的似然比会削弱更新信号。与此同时，针对生成式策略的专用方法往往依赖多候选生成与基于评判器的筛选，虽能提升整体回报，但对策略本身的改进有限。我们提出了DR-APO（解耦表示的优势引导策略优化），通过优势引导的目标改进和与表示兼容的直接动作拟合，将策略改进与策略表示解耦，从而为高斯策略、扩散策略和流匹配策略提供统一的优化原则。在五项MuJoCo-v5任务中，DR-APO在高斯策略下与SAC保持竞争力，并在扩散策略和流匹配策略下取得了最优的纯策略综合表现。NavDP后训练将成功率（SR）在仿真环境中从70.33%提升至89.55%，在真实世界导航中从25%提升至65%。这些结果验证了从连续控制学习到具身策略后训练中，高斯策略、扩散策略和流匹配策略之间统一策略改进原则的有效性。

Authors: Runhua Zhang, Yingjie Niu, Chao Li

DEFlow: Deep Equilibrium Flow Maximum-Entropy Reinforcement Learning Manipulation

deep equilibrium flow implicit Euler integration maximum-entropy reinforcement learning soft actor-critic manipulation

简要说明：本文提出DEFlow，一种深度平衡流策略，通过隐式欧拉积分高效采样多样化的高价值动作，并将其集成到软演员-评论家算法中进行离策略训练，在多目标对接和操作任务中取得了改进。

TLDR: This paper introduces DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that uses implicit Euler integration to sample diverse high-value actions efficiently, and integrates it into soft actor-critic for off-policy training, demonstrating improvements in multi-goal docking and manipulation tasks.

Abstract: Expressive flow policies can represent multiple high-value actions, but sampling them with few integration steps while retaining tractable action densities remains challenging. We introduce DEFlow, a deep equilibrium flow policy that replaces explicit Euler sampling with implicit Euler integration and solves all intermediate actions jointly as an equilibrium system. We combine implicit differentiation with a discrete change-of-variables formula for the final-action density, enabling off-policy training within soft actor-critic without backpropagating through solver iterations. DEFlow achieves an average relative improvement of approximately 10% in mean successful coverage over the strongest baseline across four Multi-Goal docking variants. It also achieves the highest mean time-averaged return on four of five manipulation tasks, while remaining broadly competitive across five MuJoCo tasks. These results support implicit flow policies for tasks requiring both diversity and precision, at the cost of additional nonlinear and linear solves. Primary

摘要（中文）：富有表现力的流策略能够表示多种高价值动作，但在保持动作密度可解析的前提下，以少量积分步骤对其进行采样仍具挑战。我们提出了DEFlow，一种深度平衡流策略，将显式欧拉采样替换为隐式欧拉积分，并将所有中间动作联合求解为一个平衡系统。我们将隐式微分与最终动作密度的离散变量替换公式相结合，从而在不通过求解器迭代进行反向传播的情况下，实现软演员-评论家框架内的离策略训练。在四个多目标对接变体任务中，DEFlow相较于最强基线，在平均成功覆盖率上实现了约10%的相对提升。在五个操作任务中的四个任务上，DEFlow取得了最高的平均时间累积回报，同时在五个MuJoCo任务中保持了广泛的竞争力。这些结果支持隐式流策略适用于需要兼具多样性和精确性的任务，代价是增加了额外的非线性和线性求解。

Authors: Ruslan Ageev, Huaze Tang, Runqing Miao, Jiarong Li, Wenbo Ding

SHOES: Sim-to-real Hardware-adaptation via On-policy Expansion of Skills for Legged Robots Locomotion

locomotion policy adaptation sim-to-real legged robots modulation modules footwear-induced morphology changes

简要说明：SHOES 提出了一种样本高效的框架，通过冻结仿真训练的运动策略并微调轻量级调制模块，使腿式机器人适应由鞋子引起的形态变化，并在 Unitree Go2 上进行了仿真和真实世界验证。

TLDR: SHOES introduces a sample-efficient framework that freezes a simulation-trained locomotion policy and fine-tunes lightweight modulation modules to adapt legged robots to footwear-induced morphology changes, validated on a Unitree Go2 in simulation and real-world experiments.

Abstract: Humans expand their locomotion capability by wearing appropriate footwear, such as hiking boots for mountains or skates for ice. Footwear changes the ground-contact interface and enables traversal of otherwise difficult terrain. In contrast, locomotion controllers are typically trained for a fixed morphology, and their performance can degrade when shoes alter foot geometry, mass, and friction. We propose SHOES, a sample-efficient framework for adapting locomotion policies to footwear-induced morphology changes. SHOES freezes a simulation-trained nominal policy and fine-tunes only lightweight, identity-initialized modulation modules on the robot, preserving the initial behavior while enabling efficient hardware adaptation. We also introduce SafeBox, a workspace-aware waypoint sampler that constrains online adaptation within a user-defined workspace. The simulation results with a shoe-equipped Unitree Go2 show that SHOES substantially recovers locomotion performance after footwear-induced morphology changes using limited additional adaptation. Under the same adaptation budget, SHOES outperforms FiLM-only, Linear Adapter-only, and residual-RL baselines. Real-world experiments on a Unitree Go2 fitted with human shoes further evaluate the effectiveness of SHOES for hardware deployment.

摘要（中文）：人类通过穿戴合适的鞋类来扩展自身的运动能力，例如登山靴用于山地行走，溜冰鞋用于冰面滑行。鞋类改变了与地面的接触界面，使人们能够在原本难以通行的地形上行走。相比之下，运动控制策略通常针对固定形态进行训练，当鞋子改变脚的几何形状、质量和摩擦特性时，其性能可能会下降。我们提出了SHOES，一种高效采样的框架，用于使运动策略适应由鞋类引起的形态变化。SHOES冻结了仿真训练得到的标称策略，仅在机器人上微调轻量级、以恒等初始化的调制模块，从而在保留初始行为的同时实现高效的硬件适应。我们还引入了SafeBox，一种工作空间感知的路径点采样器，将在线适应限制在用户定义的工作空间内。搭载鞋子的Unitree Go2仿真结果表明，SHOES在鞋类引起的形态变化后，仅需有限的额外适应即可显著恢复运动性能。在相同的适应预算下，SHOES优于仅使用FiLM、仅使用线性适配器以及残差强化学习的基线方法。在配备人类鞋子的Unitree Go2上进行的实际实验进一步验证了SHOES在硬件部署中的有效性。

Authors: Kota Tsuruhara, Tsung-Yuan Chen, Kento Kawaharazuka

LABIT: Long-Horizon Robotic Assembly Benchmark for Industrial Tasks Manipulation

long-horizon manipulation robotic assembly benchmark DIN-norm assembly force-position control assembly complexity taxonomy

简要说明：LABIT 是一个用于工业长时程机器人装配任务的基准，包含DIN标准操作、复杂度分类和新性能指标，并以力位控制作为基线进行评估。

TLDR: LABIT is a benchmark for long-horizon robotic assembly tasks with DIN-norm primitives, a complexity taxonomy, and a new performance metric, evaluated with force-position control baselines.

Abstract: Robot learning has undergone significant advancements in the domain of compliant control and robotic assembly. The development of novel methodologies has transcended the capacity to address discrete tasks, such as grasping or inserting, and has evolved to encompass the comprehensive construction of entire assemblies. Conventional benchmarks, which are predominantly focused on single tasks, are no longer adequate to address the complexity and interconnected nature of modern manufacturing processes. Consequently, the necessity for benchmarks to encompass a broader spectrum of assembly and subassembly steps is becoming apparent. In light of these developments, we propose LABIT, an industrial robotic assembly benchmark for long-horizon manipulation. This benchmark encompasses DIN-norm assembly tasks, including screwing, placing, inserting, and snapping, under both high and low tolerance conditions. The successive nature of these assembly steps implies that prior errors can influence subsequent manipulation. Consequently, this benchmark is particularly relevant for assessing the robustness of intelligent robotic systems. The proposed benchmarking protocols and novel performance metric, based on a taxonomy of assembly complexity in conjunction with the comprehensive list of parts and their corresponding CAD models, serve as essential tools for research and development in the field. To provide a baseline, we evaluate the benchmark using traditional force-position control and report reliability and score metrics per primitive, subtask, assembly category, and subassembly. Accompanying data is available at https://irp-hka.github.io/robotic-assembly-benchmark/.

摘要（中文）：机器人学习在柔顺控制与机器人装配领域取得了显著进展。新方法的发展已超越处理离散任务（如抓取或插入）的能力范畴，逐步拓展至完整构建整个装配体的综合层面。传统基准测试主要聚焦于单一任务，已不足以应对现代制造流程的复杂性及其相互关联性。因此，基准测试需涵盖更广泛的装配及子装配步骤，这一需求日益凸显。鉴于上述发展动态，我们提出了LABIT——一个面向长时域操控的工业机器人装配基准。该基准涵盖了DIN标准装配任务，包括拧紧、放置、插入及卡扣，并在高、低公差条件下进行测试。这些装配步骤的连续性意味着先前的误差可能影响后续操作，因此该基准对评估智能机器人系统的鲁棒性尤为重要。基于装配复杂度分类体系，结合零件完整清单及其对应CAD模型，我们提出的基准测试协议与新型性能指标，为该领域的研究与开发提供了关键工具。作为基线，我们采用传统力位控制对基准进行评估，并报告各原始动作、子任务、装配类别及子装配的可靠性与评分指标。配套数据可在https://irp-hka.github.io/robotic-assembly-benchmark/获取。

Authors: Constantin Schempp, Christian Friedrich, Luca Kofler, Laura Suhm

ClothAtlas: Joint Garment Identification and State Estimation under Self-Occlusion Manipulation

garment manipulation flow matching self-occlusion point cloud canonical meshes

简要说明：ClothAtlas 通过共享的图条件流匹配模型，从部分点云中联合识别衣物并估计其完整形态，在自遮挡下提高了衣物识别和抓取目标定位的准确性。

TLDR: ClothAtlas jointly identifies garments and estimates their full configurations from partial point clouds using a shared graph-conditioned flow-matching model, improving garment identification and grasp-target localization under self-occlusion.

Abstract: Garment manipulation requires inferring both garment identity and complete configuration from partial, self-occluded observations. This creates a chicken-and-egg problem: completing a partial observation requires a garment-specific deformation prior, while identifying the garment requires a configuration that explains the observation. We introduce ClothAtlas, which jointly identifies garments and estimates their complete configurations from partial point clouds and a library of canonical meshes. A shared graph-conditioned flow-matching model samples configurations for each candidate mesh and ranks candidates by observation fit. The model accommodates different mesh shapes, vertex counts, and connectivities, allowing new garments to be added from canonical meshes alone without retraining. On held-out DexGarmentLab garments, ClothAtlas ranks the correct mesh first among 221 candidates for all 22 test garments from a single flat observation. From a single self-occluded observation, it identifies 15/22 garments, compared with 8/22 for a deterministic graph estimator. Persistent vertex identities support grasp-target localization on real garments, reducing mean error from 15.4 to 6.4 cm overall and from 17.0 to 8.3 cm on occluded targets compared with dense descriptor matching. Project page: https://clothatlas.github.io/

摘要（中文）：衣物操作需要从部分、自遮挡的观测中推断出衣物的身份和完整配置。这形成了一个“鸡生蛋”的问题：补全部分观测需要衣物特定的形变先验，而识别衣物则需要一个能够解释观测的配置。我们提出了ClothAtlas，该方法能够从部分点云和规范网格库中联合识别衣物并估计其完整配置。一个共享的基于图条件的流匹配模型为每个候选网格采样配置，并根据观测拟合度对候选进行排序。该模型适应不同的网格形状、顶点数量和连通性，使得仅凭规范网格即可添加新衣物而无需重新训练。在留出的DexGarmentLab衣物上，ClothAtlas从单次平铺观测中即将全部22件测试衣物的正确网格排在221个候选中的第一位。从单次自遮挡观测中，它能识别出15/22件衣物，而确定性图估计器仅能识别8/22件。持久的顶点身份支持在真实衣物上进行抓取目标定位，与密集描述子匹配相比，总体平均误差从15.4厘米降至6.4厘米，遮挡目标上的误差从17.0厘米降至8.3厘米。项目页面：https://clothatlas.github.io/

Authors: Jens Lundell, Alberta Longhini, Lei Shu, Hemal Arora, Evan Robert, Carlota Parés-Morlans, Marcel Büsching, Mårten Björkman, Jeannette Bohg

Embodied Skill Bench: Benchmarking How Well Agents with Embodied Skills Perform on Physical Tasks Manipulation

embodied skills LLM agents VLA policies Agent-Directed Reuse LIBERO-Pro

简要说明：EmbodiedSkillBench 将1052个资源打包为250个具身技能，并在100个扰动LIBERO-Pro任务上评测LLM智能体，发现技能提升弱智能体但限制强智能体，而智能体导向复用(ADR)在几乎不损失性能的情况下提升效率。

TLDR: EmbodiedSkillBench packages 250 embodied skills from 1,052 resources and benchmarks LLM agents on 100 perturbed LIBERO-Pro tasks, showing that skills boost weaker agents but restrict strong agents, while Agent-Directed Reuse (ADR) improves efficiency with minimal performance loss.

Abstract: LLM agents increasingly control robots using VLA policies, perception models, and procedural knowledge. These modules are difficult to reuse because their interfaces, embodiment assumptions, and conditions of use differ, and their benefits on physical tasks remain unclear. We package them as embodied skills that extend agent skills with explicit embodiment assumptions and conditions of use, building 250 action, perception, and experience skills from 1,052 resources. On this basis we introduce EmbodiedSkillBench, which runs an agent in a closed observation-action loop and records success, actions, tokens, and wall-clock time. It supports three modes: native control, skill-only execution, and Agent-Directed Reuse (ADR), a mode we propose in which the agent keeps its native controls and decides for each skill whether to invoke, modify, or ignore it. Across four agents on 100 perturbed LIBERO-Pro tasks, we find that skills help an agent only as far as they exceed what it can already do. Skill-only execution lifts GPT-5.6-Sol from 11% to 63% and Kimi-K3 and Claude-Opus-5 by about 20 points, while cutting their token usage by 58% to 85%. Yet all four agents then end up between 61% and 64%, and GPT-6-Astra falls from 92% under native control to 61%. This suggests that as agents grow stronger, the role of embodied skills shifts from supplying missing capability to reducing cost: GPT-6-Astra already solves most tasks through native control, so restricting it to skills removes more than it adds. Under ADR, which lets it keep native control and call skills selectively, GPT-6-Astra recovers to 85%, within 7 points of native control, while using 14.1% fewer tokens and 11.9% less time. With Jev as a skill choosing motion directions and gripper actions, it reaches 81% with 50% fewer tokens and 57% less time. The code is available at https://github.com/HanZhi306/EmbodiedSkill-Bench.

摘要（中文）：LLM智能体越来越多地利用VLA策略、感知模型和程序性知识来控制机器人。这些模块因接口、具身假设和使用条件各异而难以复用，且其在物理任务上的收益尚不明确。我们将它们封装为具身技能，为智能体技能扩展了明确的具身假设和使用条件，基于1,052个资源构建了250个动作、感知和经验技能。在此基础上，我们提出了EmbodiedSkillBench，该基准在封闭的观察-动作循环中运行智能体，并记录成功率、动作、令牌数和墙钟时间。它支持三种模式：原生控制、仅技能执行，以及智能体定向复用（ADR）——这是我们提出的一种模式，智能体保留其原生控制，并自主决定对每个技能是调用、修改还是忽略。在100个扰动LIBERO-Pro任务上对四个智能体进行评估，我们发现技能只有在超出智能体已有能力时才能带来增益。仅技能执行使GPT-5.6-Sol从11%提升至63%，使Kimi-K3和Claude-Opus-5提升约20个百分点，同时将它们的令牌使用量削减58%至85%。然而，四个智能体最终都介于61%和64%之间，且GPT-6-Astra从原生控制下的92%降至61%。这表明，随着智能体能力增强，具身技能的角色从补充缺失能力转向降低成本：GPT-6-Astra已能通过原生控制解决大多数任务，因此仅限定其使用技能反而得不偿失。在ADR模式下，GPT-6-Astra保留原生控制并有选择地调用技能，恢复至85%，与原生控制相差7个百分点以内，同时令牌使用量减少14.1%，时间减少11.9%。当使用Jev来选择运动方向和夹爪动作时，它达到81%的成功率，令牌使用量减少50%，时间减少57%。代码见https://github.com/HanZhi306/EmbodiedSkill-Bench。

Authors: Zhi Han, Zihan Guo, Chenxi Zeng, Zicai Cui, Yue Xin, Ming Zhou, Dongzhan Zhou, Weinan Zhang, Yang Li

MSC: Multi-Stage Caster-aware Control Framework with Uncertainty-Aware NMPC and RL-based Execution Layer RLRobot

uncertainty-aware NMPC reinforcement learning execution layer caster-aware control mobile robot control Isaac Sim validation

简要说明：本文提出了一种多阶段脚轮感知控制框架，结合不确定性感知NMPC和基于强化学习的执行层，以减少工业移动机器人在脚轮敏感操作中的规划-执行偏差并提高跟踪鲁棒性。

TLDR: This paper proposes a multi-stage caster-aware control framework combining uncertainty-aware NMPC and a reinforcement learning-based execution layer to improve tracking robustness and reduce planning-execution gaps for industrial mobile robots with freely swiveling casters.

Abstract: Freely swiveling casters are widely adopted in industrial AMRs/SDVs for their mechanical simplicity and load capacity. However, caster misalignment during low-speed or high-curvature maneuvers induces strong contact nonlinearities, widening the planning-execution gap between commanded $(v, ω)$ and realized motion. Existing caster-aware strategies are highly sensitive to state-estimation reliability, causing unstable execution in uncertain transition regimes. To address this, we present Multi-Stage Caster-aware Control (MSC), a planning-execution integrated hierarchical framework featuring two core mechanisms. First, an uncertainty-aware NMPC (CU-MPC) dynamically schedules caster-aware costs and input regularization using predictive uncertainty to suppress overly aggressive maneuvers. Second, a reinforcement learning-based execution layer estimates and predicts caster states under partial observability, transforming high-level velocity commands into physically executable wheel speeds adapted to current contact conditions. Validations in Isaac Sim and real robots demonstrate that MSC offers a clear comparative advantage over existing decoupled compensation approaches by significantly improving caster-state estimation accuracy, minimizing misalignment, and enhancing tracking robustness in caster-sensitive maneuvers.

摘要（中文）：自由旋转脚轮因其机械结构简单且承载能力强，被广泛应用于工业自主移动机器人（AMR）与智能驾驶车辆（SDV）。然而，在低速或高曲率机动过程中，脚轮不对中会引发强烈的接触非线性，导致指令速度\((v, ω)\)与实际运动之间的规划-执行偏差扩大。现有基于脚轮感知的策略对状态估计的可靠性高度敏感，在不确定的过渡工况下容易出现执行不稳定。针对这一问题，本文提出了一种多阶段脚轮感知控制（MSC）框架，该框架集规划与执行为一体，采用分层结构，包含两大核心机制：其一，基于不确定性的模型预测控制（CU-MPC），利用预测不确定性动态调度脚轮感知相关代价与输入正则化项，以抑制过于激进的机动行为；其二，基于强化学习的执行层，在部分可观测条件下对脚轮状态进行估计与预测，将高层速度指令转化为适应当前接触条件的物理可执行轮速。在Isaac Sim仿真平台及真实机器人上的验证结果表明，相较于现有的解耦补偿方法，MSC在脚轮状态估计精度、不对中抑制以及脚轮敏感机动中的跟踪鲁棒性方面均展现出明显优势。

Authors: Jinho Park, Jeongtae Lee, Jeonghyeok Lim, Keun Ha Choi, Kyung-Soo Kim

One-Shot Learning for Double-Shot Latte Art: Adapting Cobot Pouring Skills with Dynamic Movement Primitives Manipulation

one-shot learning Dynamic Movement Primitives robot pouring skill generalization phase segmentation

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于机器人拿铁艺术拉花的单次学习系统，将单个示范分解为五个阶段并编码为笛卡尔动态运动基元，从而降低误差并适应不同杯型。

TLDR: This paper presents a one-shot learning system for robotic latte art pouring, segmenting a single demonstration into five phases encoded as Cartesian Dynamic Movement Primitives, which reduces errors and generalizes to different cup sizes.

Abstract: Latte art is a complex task requiring dexterity and precision, making it a challenging and commercially relevant task. A one-shot learning system is employed in which a single barista demonstration is segmented into five functionally distinct phases, each encoded as an independent Cartesian Dynamic Movement Primitive (CDMP) with its own parameters. Against a single-CDMP baseline, per-phase encoding reduces transition endpoint error by 3.2-4.5 times and art-stroke shape error by 2.7 times, reproducing jug tilt to below 1 degree RMS in the pouring phases. The learnt pour scales from a 280mL to a 400mL cup through a single spatial offset and a scaled recipe, with no re-demonstration. The phase-based CDMP approach generalises beyond latte art to any demonstration task whose phases have distinct spatial or temporal requirements whilst demonstrating the ability to adapt reproductions to suit different task requirements.

摘要（中文）：拉花艺术是一项需要灵巧与精准的复杂任务，使其具有挑战性且具有商业相关性。采用一次性学习系统，将单个咖啡师演示分割为五个功能上不同的阶段，每个阶段被编码为具有独立参数的独立笛卡尔动态运动原语（CDMP）。与单一CDMP基线相比，分阶段编码将过渡端点误差降低了3.2-4.5倍，将艺术笔触形状误差降低了2.7倍，并在倾倒阶段将壶倾角复现误差降至1度均方根以下。通过学习，所获得的倾倒操作可通过单一空间偏移及调整后的配方，从280毫升杯型扩展至400毫升杯型，而无需重新演示。这种基于阶段的CDMP方法不仅适用于拉花艺术，还可推广至任何阶段具有不同空间或时间要求的演示任务，同时展示了调整复现以适应不同任务要求的能力。

Authors: Zain Khan, Victor Hernandez Moreno, Dinh Tung Le

Constrained Differentiable Policy Learning for Safe Quadrotor Navigation RLRobot

constrained optimization differentiable simulation quadrotor navigation primal-dual safety constraints

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于四旋翼安全导航的约束可微分策略学习框架，通过原始-对偶优化和基于有界间隙的约束函数显式处理避障，在保证安全性的同时提升了性能，并实现了零样本迁移到真实四旋翼。

TLDR: This paper introduces a constrained differentiable policy learning framework for quadrotor navigation, using primal-dual optimization with a bounded clearance-based constraint and log-mean-exp aggregation to explicitly enforce obstacle avoidance, achieving improved safety-performance trade-offs and zero-shot transfer to real quadrotors.

Abstract: Differentiable simulation enables efficient policy optimization through analytic gradients, yet safety is commonly incorporated as a weighted penalty, requiring manual tuning of the trade-off between task performance and constraint satisfaction. We instead formulate obstacle avoidance as an explicit constraint and train quadrotor policies using primal--dual gradient descent--ascent through a differentiable simulator. We introduce two key components to enable effective constrained training. First, we propose a bounded clearance-based constraint function that provides informative gradients around the safety boundary while preventing large violations from destabilizing primal--dual optimization. Second, we introduce log-mean-exp (LME) aggregation to smoothly emphasize critical per-step safety violations across a trajectory and training batch within a single constraint governed by one dual variable. Together, these components enable the desired safety level to be specified directly while balancing constraint satisfaction and task completion. We theoretically prove that the proposed optimization with differentiable simulation converges to feasible policy under mild assumptions. Experiments demonstrate improved safety--performance trade-offs over fixed-penalty and existing policy-learning baselines, as well as generalization to denser out-of-distribution environments. Finally, the learned policy transfers zero-shot to Gazebo/PX4 and a physical quadrotor without additional fine-tuning.

摘要（中文）：可微分仿真通过解析梯度实现了高效的策略优化，然而安全性通常以加权惩罚项的形式纳入，需要手动调节任务性能与约束满足之间的权衡。我们转而将避障表述为显式约束，并通过可微分仿真器采用原始-对偶梯度下降-上升方法训练四旋翼策略。我们引入了两个关键组件以实现有效的约束训练。首先，我们提出了一种基于有界安全距离的约束函数，该函数在安全边界附近提供信息丰富的梯度，同时防止较大的违规行为破坏原始-对偶优化的稳定性。其次，我们引入了对数-均值-指数（LME）聚合方法，以平滑地强调轨迹及训练批次中关键的单步安全违规，并将其统一纳入由单一对偶变量控制的约束中。这两个组件共同作用，使得能够直接指定所需的安全水平，同时平衡约束满足与任务完成度。我们从理论上证明，在温和假设下，所提出的可微分仿真优化方法能够收敛到可行策略。实验表明，与固定惩罚及现有策略学习基线相比，该方法在安全-性能权衡上表现更优，且能泛化至更密集的分布外环境。最后，学习得到的策略无需额外微调即可零样本迁移至Gazebo/PX4仿真环境及实体四旋翼平台。

Authors: Yan Rui Tan, Praveen Krishnapur, Zeyu Feng, Han Bao, Yew-Soon Ong, Fan Shi

A Hardware-Partitioned micro-ROS Mini-Vehicle for Operator-Supervised Neural Driving AutonomousDriving

hardware-partitioned micro-ROS embedded neural driving closed-loop wireless control

简要说明：本文提出了一种用于嵌入式神经驾驶研究的低成本、硬件分区微型Ackermann车辆，其中ESP32摄像头节点将帧传输到主机进行神经推理，而ESP32-S3底盘控制器负责安全关键的执行。该平台在十二次自主会话中展示了可靠的闭环神经驾驶，零碰撞，突出了分区微控制器级车辆在嵌入式AI和无线控制研究中的可行性。

TLDR: This paper presents a low-cost, hardware-partitioned miniature Ackermann vehicle for embedded neural-driving research, where an ESP32 camera node streams frames to a host for neural inference while an ESP32-S3 chassis controller handles safety-critical actuation. The platform demonstrated reliable closed-loop neural driving across twelve autonomous sessions with zero collisions, highlighting the viability of partitioned microcontroller-class vehicles for embedded AI and wireless control research.

Abstract: We present a low-cost miniature Ackermann vehicle for embedded neural-driving research, organized as a hardware-partitioned perceive-decide-act agent: an ESP32 camera node streams frames over Wi-Fi to a host computer, where neural inference and state estimation run, while an ESP32-S3 chassis controller executes safety-critical actuation in a 100 Hz per-wheel proportional-integral-derivative (PID) loop beneath a micro-ROS client. The partition isolates real-time control and safety on the vehicle while learning-based components run off-board, supervised by an operator from a gamepad. We characterize the complete pipeline during real closed-loop neural driving. Wireless sensing, rather than neural inference, dominates latency, with a 59.5 ms median capture-to-actuation delay; the platform absorbed wireless variability by holding the last safe command under a firmware watchdog, operating across twelve autonomous sessions with zero collisions or manual interventions; and encoder-inertial-measurement-unit (IMU) fusion cut odometry loop-closure error by 22%. These results indicate that carefully partitioned microcontroller-class vehicles support reproducible experiments in embedded AI, wireless control, and operator-supervised autonomous driving. The platform software is open source.

摘要（中文）：我们提出了一种低成本的迷你阿克曼转向车辆，专为嵌入式神经驾驶研究而设计，其架构按照硬件分区组织为感知-决策-执行智能体：一个ESP32摄像头节点通过Wi-Fi将视频帧流传输至主机计算机，在主机上运行神经推理与状态估计，而一个ESP32-S3底盘控制器则在微ROS客户端之下，以每轮100 Hz的轮速比例-积分-微分（PID）控制环路执行安全关键的驱动操作。该分区将实时控制与安全性隔离在车辆端，而基于学习的组件则在车外运行，并由操作员通过游戏手柄进行监督。我们在实际闭环神经驾驶过程中对整个流水线进行了性能表征。无线感知（而非神经推理）主导了延迟，其中从捕捉到执行的中位延迟为59.5毫秒；该平台通过固件看门狗保持最后的安全指令来吸收无线变异性，在十二次自主会话中实现了零碰撞和零人工干预；此外，编码器-惯性测量单元（IMU）融合将里程计回环误差降低了22%。这些结果表明，经过仔细分区的微控制器级车辆能够支持嵌入式AI、无线控制以及操作员监督的自动驾驶中的可复现实验。该平台软件为开源发布。

Authors: Gustavo Claudio Karl Couto, Eric Aislan Antonelo, Gabriel George Zipperer

Efficient Hybrid Hard--Soft Signal Temporal Logic MPC for Driving under Multimodal Uncertainty AutonomousDriving

Signal Temporal Logic Model Predictive Control multimodal uncertainty motion planning interactive traffic

简要说明：本文提出一种用于自动驾驶的混合硬-软信号时序逻辑（STL）MPC框架，将最小距离和速度约束作为硬限制，同时通过软STL鲁棒性项优化舒适度和交互质量，并通过优化降低计算成本。

TLDR: This paper proposes a hybrid hard-soft Signal Temporal Logic (STL) MPC framework for automated driving that keeps minimum-distance and speed constraints as hard limits while shaping comfort and interaction via soft STL robustness terms, with optimizations to reduce computational cost.

Abstract: Motion planning for automated vehicles in interactive traffic has to simultaneously ensure safety, respect traffic rules, and maintain comfortable progress under multi-modal behavior uncertainty. Imposing all these requirements as hard constraints reduces feasibility, whereas treating them all as costs allows safety-critical requirements to be traded against progress. We propose a hybrid hard--soft Signal Temporal Logic (STL) MPC framework that optimizes a single shared ego trajectory against every retained behavior hypothesis: minimum-distance and speed predicates are imposed as explicit hard constraints, while soft STL robustness terms shape clearance, comfort, and interaction quality within the resulting feasible driving corridor. This retains robustness to discrete interaction modes without branch-specific contingent ego policies. We further identify substantial symbolic graph-construction overhead and introduce reachability-certified relevance screening and vectorized symbolic construction to reduce computational cost while preserving the feasible set and objective. Closed-loop Monte Carlo evaluation over six highway and intersection scenarios shows the highest strict success rate among the compared planners with no observed collisions or rule violations, at roughly a quarter of the planning latency of the unoptimized formulation. An ablation study separates the two layers: the hard constraints define the safety envelope, while the soft terms improve clearance and motion quality within it.

摘要（中文）：交互式交通中自动驾驶车辆的运动规划，必须在多模态行为不确定性下同时确保安全性、遵守交通规则，并维持舒适的行驶进度。将这些要求全部作为硬约束会降低可行性，而全部作为代价函数又会使安全关键要求在与行驶进度的权衡中被牺牲。我们提出一种混合硬-软信号时序逻辑（STL）模型预测控制（MPC）框架，该框架针对每一个保留的行为假设优化单一共享的自车轨迹：最小距离和速度谓词作为显式硬约束施加，而软STL鲁棒性项则在所得可行行驶走廊内塑造安全间距、舒适性和交互质量。这在不依赖分支特定的条件自车策略的情况下，保持了对离散交互模式的鲁棒性。我们进一步识别出符号图构建中的大量开销，并引入可达性认证的相关性筛选和向量化符号构建，以在保持可行集和目标函数不变的同时降低计算成本。在六个高速公路和交叉路口场景下的闭环蒙特卡洛评估表明，该规划器在对比的规划器中取得了最高的严格成功率，未观察到碰撞或违规行为，且规划时延约为未优化公式的四分之一。消融研究将两层分离：硬约束定义了安全包络，而软项则提高了包络内的安全间距和运动质量。

Authors: Kumar Manas, Adrian Paschke

XAI-Guided Fourier Domain Generalisation for Pure-Simulation Sim-to-Real Deep Reinforcement Learning AutonomousDriving

explainable AI Fourier domain generalization sim-to-real deep reinforcement learning autonomous driving

简要说明：本文提出了XFD，一种基于可解释人工智能引导的傅里叶域泛化框架，用于纯仿真到现实的深度强化学习自动驾驶，通过策略条件化频谱扰动和鲁棒策略优化提升了零样本真实世界部署的性能。

TLDR: This paper introduces XFD, an XAI-guided Fourier domain generalization framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real deep reinforcement learning in autonomous driving, which improves zero-shot real-world deployment by applying policy-conditioned spectral perturbations and robust policy optimization.

Abstract: Deep reinforcement learning has shown strong potential for vision-based autonomous driving, but policies trained in simulation often suffer severe performance degradation when deployed in the real world. Existing sim-to-real methods commonly address this gap through image-transfer-based domain adaptation or policy-agnostic domain randomisation. However, the former requires laborious acquisition of target-domain data and is often limited to the deployment domain, whereas the latter introduces unguided perturbations that may not reflect the underlying sim-to-real discrepancy, leading to suboptimal transfer performance. To overcome these limitations, we propose XFD, an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-guided Fourier domain generalisation framework for pure-simulation sim-to-real reinforcement learning. The proposed framework extracts explainability attribution maps from simulated observations, and converts these attributions into policy-conditioned Fourier-domain interventions. By perturbing appearance-sensitive spectral components while preserving task-defining spatial structures, XFD constructs robustness-enhancing visual domains entirely within simulation. Subsequently, the proposed robust policy optimisation guides the policy towards attending to task-critical features while suppressing sensitivity to irrelevant visual information. Extensive experiments in simulation and zero-shot real-world deployment demonstrate that XFD consistently improves traveled distance and reward over standard policy and randomly domain-randomised baseline, especially on unseen maps with cluttered backgrounds. Attribution-based analysis further proves that the proposed policy preserves more consistent task-relevant visual evidence across simulation and real-world observations.

摘要（中文）：深度强化学习在基于视觉的自动驾驶领域展现出巨大潜力，但仿真环境中训练的策略在现实世界部署时往往出现严重的性能退化。现有的仿真到现实迁移方法通常通过基于图像转换的域适应或与策略无关的域随机化来弥补这一差距。然而，前者需要耗费大量人力采集目标域数据，且往往局限于部署域；后者引入的随机扰动缺乏引导，可能无法反映潜在的仿真到现实差异，从而导致迁移性能欠佳。为克服上述局限，我们提出XFD——一种基于可解释人工智能（XAI）引导的傅里叶域泛化框架，用于纯仿真环境下的仿真到现实强化学习。该框架从仿真观测中提取可解释性归因图，并将这些归因转化为策略条件下的傅里叶域干预。通过在保留任务定义空间结构的同时扰动外观敏感的光谱成分，XFD完全在仿真内部构建增强鲁棒性的视觉域。随后，所提出的鲁棒策略优化引导策略关注任务关键特征，同时抑制对无关视觉信息的敏感性。在仿真环境及零样本现实部署中的大量实验表明，XFD在行驶距离和奖励方面持续优于标准策略和随机域随机化基线，尤其在背景杂乱的全新地图上表现突出。基于归因的分析进一步证明，所提出的策略在仿真与现实观测之间保持了更一致的任务相关视觉证据。

Authors: Wei Yao, Chuyao Wang, Ziwei Wang, Nabil Aouf

World Models Need a Physical Registry: Learning Internal Predictive States for Physically Plausible World Models WorldModel

video world models physical plausibility predictive dynamics diffusion transformer future ranking

简要说明：本文提出物理注册表，在视频扩散变压器内部显式编码预测动态，提升视频世界模型的物理合理性，并支持未来生成的早期排序。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Physical Registry, a set of temporally grounded slots inside a video diffusion transformer that explicitly encode predictive dynamics, improving physical plausibility and enabling early ranking of generated futures in video world models.

Abstract: Video world models must generate physically plausible futures, not just realistic frames. Existing approaches typically use semantic, physical, or predictive information to guide the visual generation stream, leaving a fundamental question: where inside the generator should predictions of scene evolution live? Standard video tokens jointly encode appearance and dynamics, but provide no distinct state for learning and reading predictive dynamics. We answer this question with the Physical Registry: temporally grounded registry slots inside a video DiT that are initialized from an observation-conditioned forecast, co-evolve with video tokens, and receive future-representation supervision, making predictive dynamics an explicit, readable state of the generator. In a controlled comparison of predictive-state interfaces on Physics-IQ Verified, Physical Registry improves vanilla fine-tuning by 9.9/8.7 points on I2V/V2V, the largest gain among the interfaces we compare. Across all Cosmos and WAN backbones, Physical Registry improves Physics-IQ Verified scores. With only 0.45% additional parameters, it enables Cosmos 3 Nano 16B to surpass the published I2V score of Cosmos 3 Super 64B (43.56 vs. 42.7). On WorldModelBench, it also improves physical adherence and the total score for all four evaluated backbones. Because the registry becomes candidate-specific while remaining readable, the Physical Registry Selector (PRS) ranks emerging futures by how far their intermediate registry readouts depart from the shared forecast before full denoising is complete. Across four backbones, this selection improves I2V scores by 5.6-15.9% without completed-video external scoring. Together, these results support a broader principle: dynamics prediction should live as an explicit model state that co-evolves with the video representation. Project page: https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/

摘要（中文）：视频世界模型必须生成物理上合理的未来，而不仅仅是逼真的帧。现有方法通常利用语义、物理或预测信息来引导视觉生成流，这引出一个根本性问题：生成器内部究竟应在何处存放场景演化的预测？标准的视频令牌联合编码外观与动态，但并未为学习和读取预测性动态提供独立的状态。我们以“物理注册表”（Physical Registry）回答这一问题：在视频DiT内部，基于观测条件预测初始化、与视频令牌协同演化，并接收未来表征监督的时间锚定注册槽，从而使预测性动态成为生成器显式、可读的状态。在Physics-IQ Verified上对预测状态接口进行受控比较中，物理注册表在I2V/V2V任务上相较于朴素微调分别提升9.9/8.7分，是所比较接口中增益最大的。在所有Cosmos和WAN骨干网络上，物理注册表均提升了Physics-IQ Verified得分。仅增加0.45%的参数，即可使Cosmos 3 Nano 16B超越已发表的Cosmos 3 Super 64B的I2V分数（43.56对42.7）。在WorldModelBench上，它同样提升了全部四个评估骨干网络的物理一致性与总分。由于注册表在保持可读性的同时具备候选特异性，物理注册表选择器（PRS）可以在完整去噪完成之前，根据中间注册表读数偏离共享预测的程度对涌现式未来进行排序。在四个骨干网络上，该选择方法在无需完整视频外部评分的情况下，将I2V分数提升了5.6%—15.9%。综合来看，这些结果支持一个更广泛的原则：动态预测应作为与视频表征协同演化的显式模型状态而存在。项目页面：https://grainsack.github.io/physical-registry/

Authors: Shinseong Kim, Jaeseok Jeong, Jianlong Fu, Youngjung Uh

ADAPT: Audio-Depth Action Planning with Transition-Aware Rewards for Lights-Out Industrial Navigation RLRobot

audio-depth navigation transition-aware reward shaping lights-out industrial spatial audio closed-loop RL

简要说明：ADAPT 提出一种结合空间音频与深度信息、并采用过渡感知奖励塑形的动作规划框架，用于实现无可见光工业环境下的免RGB导航，并引入 DarkNav-Bench 基准，在闭环成功率上表现优异。

TLDR: ADAPT proposes an audio-depth action-planning framework with transition-aware reward shaping for RGB-free navigation in lights-out industrial environments, introducing DarkNav-Bench and demonstrating strong closed-loop success with spatial audio and depth inputs.

Abstract: Vision-language-action models for embodied navigation typically rely on RGB observations, limiting their applicability in lights-out industrial environments where visible illumination may be unavailable. We study illumination-independent navigation using spatial audio for target localization and depth for obstacle-aware geometry. To support this setting, we introduce DarkNav-Bench, a benchmark with 24 industrial scenes and four progressively challenging acoustic conditions. We further propose ADAPT, an audio-depth action-planning framework equipped with spatial-audio perception and optimized for closed-loop navigation through reinforcement learning (RL). Our key RL contribution, transition-aware reward shaping (TARS), defines a pose-aware shortest-action potential over a position-heading graph. Unlike conventional geodesic-progress rewards, TARS accounts for both feasible movements and in-place rotations, providing action-consistent feedback for policy optimization. Experiments show that ADAPT consistently outperforms training-based navigation baselines and zero-shot multimodal models on both seen and unseen scenes. On unseen environments, it achieves 90.6% success under Clean conditions and retains 60.0% success under the most challenging Localized Noise setting. These results demonstrate the potential of spatial audio and depth as complementary modalities for reliable RGB-free navigation in lights-out industrial environments.

摘要（中文）：具身导航的视觉-语言-动作模型通常依赖RGB观测，这限制了其在可能缺乏可见照明的无光工业环境中的适用性。我们研究利用空间音频进行目标定位、利用深度信息进行障碍感知几何建模的照明无关导航方法。为支持这一设定，我们引入了DarkNav-Bench基准，包含24个工业场景和四种难度递进的声学条件。我们进一步提出ADAPT——一种音频-深度动作规划框架，配备空间音频感知能力，并通过强化学习（RL）优化闭环导航。我们的核心RL贡献在于过渡感知奖励塑造（TARS），该机制在位置-朝向图上定义了姿势感知的最短动作势能。与传统测地线进度奖励不同，TARS同时考虑可行运动和原地旋转，为策略优化提供与动作一致的反馈。实验表明，ADAPT在已见和未见场景中均 consistently 优于基于训练的导航基线和零样本多模态模型。在未见环境中，ADAPT在Clean条件下达到90.6%的成功率，在最具挑战性的Localized Noise设定下仍保持60.0%的成功率。这些结果证明了空间音频与深度作为互补模态，在无光工业环境中实现可靠的无需RGB导航的潜力。

Authors: Wenjun Huang, Shenghao Fu, Yian Jin, Yang Ni, Yifan Li, Lichi Li, Xingjian Diao, Pengfei Zhang, Yutong Song, Hanning Chen, Jiarui Cui, Tianyu Yang, Shilong Li, Yu Kong, Mohsen Imani

Multics: Generative Multi-Player World Model with Hierarchical Communication WorldModel

multi-player world model hierarchical communication group tokens dynamic grouping video generation

简要说明：Multics提出了一种用于多玩家视频生成世界模型的分层通信框架，通过组令牌和预算受限的动态分组，在保持跨玩家一致性和可控性的同时，高效扩展到更多玩家。

TLDR: Multics proposes a hierarchical communication framework for multi-player video generation world models, using group tokens and budget-constrained dynamic grouping to scale to more players efficiently while maintaining cross-player consistency and controllability.

Abstract: Multi-player interactive world models aim to simulate shared environments from multiple players' perspectives, but achieving robust generation while scaling to more players remains challenging. Existing approaches that rely on fully-connected communication (e.g., Solaris) incur quadratic attention costs as the number of players grows, while centralized approaches (e.g., $γ$-World) suffer from interference between unrelated events in a shared global representation. To address these challenges, we present Multics, a multi-player video generation framework with hierarchical communication that structures information exchange across player, group, and global levels. This hierarchy introduces group tokens into self-attention as intermediate group-level representations that aggregate locally relevant player information. These tokens connect to global tokens for cross-group communication, while the hierarchical topology limits direct mixing between unrelated local events. Group-token parameters are shared across group slots, allowing the same communication module to accommodate varying numbers of players without introducing new group-specific parameters. We further propose budget-constrained dynamic grouping based on recent camera trajectories, which adaptively groups relevant players while limiting unnecessary communication. Experiments demonstrate that Multics achieves state-of-the-art performance in 4- and 6-player settings, with improved cross-player consistency, player-specific action and camera controllability, and interference robustness. Moreover, Multics generalizes from 4-player training to 6-, 8-, and 10-player inference without retraining, while reducing self-attention computation compared with fully-connected communication.

摘要（中文）：多玩家交互式世界模型旨在从多个玩家的视角模拟共享环境，但在扩展到更多玩家时实现稳健生成仍具挑战性。现有依赖全连接通信的方法（如Solaris）随着玩家数量增长会产生二次方注意力计算代价，而集中式方法（如$γ$-World）则在共享全局表示中遭遇无关事件之间的干扰问题。为应对这些挑战，我们提出了Multics，一个具有层级通信机制的多玩家视频生成框架，将信息交换结构化为玩家层、组层和全局层三个层级。该层级结构将组令牌引入自注意力机制，作为聚合局部相关玩家信息的中间组级表示。这些令牌与全局令牌连接以实现跨组通信，同时层级拓扑限制了无关局部事件之间的直接混合。组令牌参数在组槽位之间共享，使得同一通信模块能够适应不同数量的玩家，而无需引入新的组特定参数。我们进一步提出了基于近期相机轨迹的预算约束动态分组方法，自适应地对相关玩家进行分组，同时限制不必要的通信。实验表明，Multics在4人和6人设置下达到了最先进的性能，在跨玩家一致性、玩家特定动作与相机可控性以及干扰鲁棒性方面均有提升。此外，Multics能够从4人训练泛化到6人、8人和10人推理而无需重新训练，同时相较于全连接通信减少了自注意力计算量。

Authors: Kaiyi Huang, Wangbo Yu, Yukun Huang, Jiwen Yu, Kunhao Liu, Donglin Yang, Wenbo Hu, Ying Shan, Xihui Liu

MARS: Systematic Multi-Level Acceleration for World Action Models WorldModel

World Action Models inference acceleration attention pruning diffusion acceleration speculative execution

简要说明：MARS 是一个无需训练、即插即用的框架，通过选择性剪枝注意力、自适应加速扩散过程以及推测性重用视觉表征，系统性地加速世界动作模型（WAM），在仿真和真实机器人基准上实现高达4倍的加速，同时将性能损失降至最低。

TLDR: MARS is a training-free, plug-and-play framework that systematically accelerates World Action Models (WAMs) by selectively pruning attention, adaptively speeding up diffusion, and speculatively reusing visual representations, achieving up to 4x speedups on simulation and real-robot benchmarks with minimal performance loss.

Abstract: World Action Models (WAMs) have emerged as a promising alternative for embodied intelligence by jointly predicting future world states and robot actions. However, their heavy visual encoding and iterative generative inference incur substantial latency, limiting their applicability to high-frequency closed-loop control. Existing training-free acceleration methods typically optimize a single stage, yielding limited speedups or degraded control under aggressive reuse. In this work, we systematically profile the inference overhead of WAMs and observe abundant redundancy across Transformer computation, diffusion denoising, and consecutive policy queries. However, the safe removal of such redundancy depends strongly on its impact on action prediction and control sensitivity. Based on these observations, we introduce \textbf{MARS}, a training-free and plug-and-play framework for multi-level WAM acceleration. MARS selectively removes low-impact attention computation, adaptively accelerates diffusion inference according to motion granularity, and speculatively reuses predicted future visual representations across consecutive queries with online verification. Together, these complementary mechanisms provide remarkable acceleration while limiting approximation error. Extensive experiments across LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboCasa show that MARS achieves up to $4.00\times$, $3.94\times$, and $2.10\times$ end-to-end speedups, respectively, while maintaining task success rate close to the original policy. Moreover, MARS generalizes across different model backbones and across simulation and real-robot experiments, substantially improving the efficiency--performance trade-off of WAM inference. Our code is available at https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MARS.

摘要（中文）：世界动作模型（WAMs）已成为具身智能领域一种颇具前景的替代方案，能够联合预测未来世界状态与机器人动作。然而，其繁重的视觉编码与迭代式生成推理带来了显著的延迟，限制了其在高频闭环控制中的适用性。现有的免训练加速方法通常只优化单个阶段，导致加速效果有限，或在激进复用情况下出现控制性能下降。在本工作中，我们系统地剖析了WAM的推理开销，并观察到Transformer计算、扩散去噪以及连续策略查询之间存在大量冗余。然而，安全地去除这些冗余在很大程度上取决于其对动作预测和控制灵敏度的具体影响。基于上述观察，我们提出了\textbf{MARS}，一个免训练、即插即用的多层级WAM加速框架。MARS选择性剔除低影响的注意力计算，根据运动粒度自适应地加速扩散推理，并通过在线验证在连续查询之间推测性地复用已预测的未来视觉表征。这些互补机制共同实现了显著的加速效果，同时将近似误差限制在可控范围内。在LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO和RoboCasa上的大量实验表明，MARS分别实现了高达$4.00\times$、$3.94\times$和$2.10\times$的端到端加速，同时将任务成功率维持在接近原始策略的水平。此外，MARS在不同模型骨干网络以及仿真与真实机器人实验中均表现出良好的泛化能力，显著改善了WAM推理的效率-性能权衡。我们的代码可在https://github.com/PKU-VaLuE-Lab/MARS获取。

Authors: Zengyuan Zuo, Yongchang Zhang, Guangyu Zhao, Tianze Zhang, Biao Wu, Meng Fang, Yiwu Zhong

Declarative Reactive Robot Behaviors from Imperative Language Models Other

LLM-based robot programming declarative reactive programming Playful language coding agents robotic behaviors

简要说明：本文研究了基于LLM的编码代理能否使用Playful脚本语言生成声明式、反应式机器人行为，并表明在专家设计的指导下，此类代理可以为开放式行为生成正确的程序。

TLDR: The paper investigates whether LLM-based coding agents can generate declarative, reactive robot behaviors using the Playful scripting language, showing that with expert-designed guidelines, such agents can produce correct programs for open-ended behaviors.

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) are predominantly trained on imperative programming languages, and existing work on LLM-based robot programming reflects this: it focuses on goal-directed tasks expressed as plans. However, many robotic applications require not tasks but behaviors--open-ended, continuous patterns of sensory-motor engagement with no termination condition (e.g., greeting visitors, patrolling an area). Such behaviors are better served by declarative and reactive programming, on which LLMs have virtually no training. We investigate whether this gap can be bridged. Using Playful, a reactive scripting language, we show that an LLM-based coding agent can generate correct declarative and reactive programs for robotic behaviors. These programs are produced from under-specified natural language descriptions, given suitable context and a set of reusable programming guidelines. The guidelines encode design principles that redirect the agent from imperative defaults toward proper reactive patterns. Developed once by an expert, they generalize across robots and behaviors. Starting from only the generic robot operating system API, the agent jointly designs both the imperative component (Python modules for sensing, acting, and evaluating) and the declarative component (the reactive script that composes them into behavior logic). The declarative nature of reactive programming supports both incremental refinement through conversational turns and one-shot generation of complete behaviors.

摘要（中文）：大型语言模型（LLMs）主要基于命令式编程语言进行训练，现有关于基于LLM的机器人编程研究也反映了这一特点：其重点在于以计划形式表达的目标导向型任务。然而，许多机器人应用所需的并非任务，而是行为——即无终止条件的开放式、连续的感官-运动交互模式（例如，迎宾、区域巡逻）。这类行为更适合采用声明式和反应式编程范式，而LLMs在此方面几乎没有训练数据。我们研究了这一差距是否能够被弥合。利用反应式脚本语言Playful，我们证明基于LLM的编码智能体能够为机器人行为生成正确的声明式和反应式程序。这些程序是在给定适当上下文和一组可复用编程指南的情况下，从不完全明确（欠限定）的自然语言描述中生成的。这些指南编码了设计原则，将智能体从命令式默认倾向引导至正确的反应式模式。指南由专家一次性制定，可跨机器人和行为进行泛化。仅从通用的机器人操作系统API出发，该智能体同时设计命令式组件（用于感知、行动和评估的Python模块）和声明式组件（将其组合为行为逻辑的反应式脚本）。反应式编程的声明式特性既支持通过对话轮次进行增量精化，也支持一次性生成完整行为。

Authors: Vincent Berenz, Tasha Kim, Bernhard Schölkopf

Belief Space Planning for Risk Signal Temporal Logic via Mixed-Integer Convex Programming RLRobot

Belief Space Planning Risk Signal Temporal Logic Mixed-Integer Convex Programming Gaussian Belief Trajectory Optimization

简要说明：本文提出了一种在高斯信念空间中针对风险信号时序逻辑（RiSTL）规划问题的混合整数凸规划方法，证明了该方法的可靠性和完备性，以及松弛问题保留全局最优输入轨迹的性质。

TLDR: This paper proposes a mixed-integer convex programming approach for planning under Risk Signal Temporal Logic (RiSTL) in Gaussian belief space, proving soundness, completeness, and global optimality of the relaxed problem for robot tasks with uncertainty.

Abstract: Signal Temporal Logic (STL) specifies robot tasks with spatio-temporal requirements, and its robustness semantics allow planning by trajectory optimization. In practice, robots estimate their state from noisy measurements, and when the information gained from a measurement depends on the state, the robot can actively reduce its uncertainty by planning in the belief space. The resulting problem is, however, generally non-convex, for which gradient-based methods are neither complete nor globally optimal. In this paper, we consider Risk STL (RiSTL) planning in Gaussian belief space and show that an information-form parameterization of the belief, together with a convex relaxation of the belief dynamics, yields a mixed-integer convex program (MICP). We prove that the MICP is sound and complete, and that the relaxation preserves the globally optimal input trajectories. We validate the effectiveness of our method in numerical simulations.

摘要（中文）：信号时序逻辑（STL）以时空要求来规范机器人任务，其鲁棒性语义使得通过轨迹优化进行规划成为可能。在实际应用中，机器人从含噪声的测量中估计其状态，当从测量中获得的信息依赖于状态本身时，机器人可以通过在置信空间中进行规划来主动降低自身的不确定性。然而，由此产生的问题通常是非凸的，基于梯度的方法既不完备也无法保证全局最优。本文研究高斯置信空间中的风险STL（RiSTL）规划问题，并证明置信度的信息形式参数化，结合置信动态的凸松弛，能够转化为混合整数凸规划（MICP）。我们证明了该MICP具有可靠性与完备性，且该松弛能够保留全局最优输入轨迹。我们通过数值仿真验证了所提方法的有效性。

Authors: Shaohang Han, Joris Verhagen, Kaier Liang, Jana Tumova

Estimating the Causal Impact of Social Navigation Signals in Corridor Scenarios Other

causal inference social navigation human-robot interaction confounding corridor scenario

简要说明：该论文使用因果推断来估计社交导航信号是否改善走廊通行成功率，表明考虑混杂因素会颠覆朴素观测分析的结论。

TLDR: The paper uses causal inference to estimate whether social navigation signals improve corridor transit success, showing that accounting for confounders reverses the conclusion of naive observational analysis.

Abstract: Deploying robots in human-shared environments requires deciding not only how to navigate, but also when dedicated social signals are worth emitting. Classic observation-based inference can be misleading in such settings: confounding factors may bias the estimated relationship between a signal and the task outcome, leading to incorrect decisions. Causal inference provides a framework for disentangling these relationships by modelling the mechanisms linking observations, actions, and outcomes, and by estimating interventional effects after accounting for confounding paths. We study a human-robot interaction scenario in a corridor and use a causal model to estimate whether a social navigation signal causally improves transit success. We represent the interaction as a causal DAG involving robot action, pedestrian occupancy, available space, task outcome, and a controlled confounder (static obstacles). We compare the interventional estimate with the observational estimate obtained by conditioning only on the robot action, which does not explicitly model interventions. Our results show that accounting for confounding variables can reverse the conclusions drawn from naive observational analysis: the observational estimate wrongly suggests that the social signal is detrimental, whereas the causal estimate shows that it is beneficial. This discrepancy highlights how failing to account for confounding can lead to incorrect conclusions and demonstrates the importance of causal models for context-aware signalling decisions in social robot navigation.

摘要（中文）：在人类共享环境中部署机器人，不仅需要决定如何导航，还需要判断何时值得发出专门的社交信号。在此类环境中，基于观测的传统推断可能具有误导性：混淆因素可能使信号与任务结果之间的估计关系产生偏差，从而引发错误决策。因果推断通过建模观测、行动与结果之间的关联机制，并在考虑混淆路径后估计干预效应，为厘清这些关系提供了框架。我们研究了一个走廊中的人机交互场景，并使用因果模型来评估社交导航信号是否在因果层面上提升了通行成功率。我们将该交互表示为一个因果有向无环图（DAG），涵盖机器人行动、行人占用、可用空间、任务结果以及一个受控混淆因素（静态障碍物）。我们将干预估计与仅以机器人行动为条件的观测估计进行比较，后者并未显式建模干预。结果表明，考虑混淆变量后，结论可能逆转基于朴素观测分析所得出的判断：观测估计错误地表明社交信号具有负面影响，而因果估计则显示其具有积极作用。这一差异突显了未考虑混淆因素可能导致错误结论的风险，并证明了在社交机器人导航中，因果模型对于情境感知的信号决策具有重要意义。

Authors: Francesco Baldo, Luca Castri, Gloria Beraldo, Nicola Bellotto

RoboBugBench: Benchmarking Automated Repair of Real Robot Software Under an Audited Behavioral Oracle Other

robot software repair ROS 2 behavioral oracle physics simulation language agents

简要说明：RoboBugBench是一个用于评估真实机器人软件自动修复的基准测试，基于ROS 2导航栈，通过物理模拟作为经过审计的行为测试基准。结果显示前沿模型仅能修复24.2%-36.4%的缺陷，表明测量修复率受测试基准局限性和补丁验证标准的影响很大。

TLDR: RoboBugBench is a benchmark for evaluating automated repair of real robot software in a ROS 2 navigation stack, using a physics simulation as an audited behavioral oracle. It shows frontier models repair only 24.2-36.4% of defects, revealing that the oracle's limitations and patch validation criteria significantly shape measured repair rates.

Abstract: Language agents increasingly modify robot software, but whether they can repair it is unmeasured, because the domain supplies no oracle to inherit: a robot bug manifests as behavior, and robot repositories ship almost no tests that capture it. We present RoboBugBench, a benchmark of 33 real, execution-validated defects in a pinned ROS 2 navigation stack, in which a candidate patch is graded by compiling it and driving the robot through a physics simulation rather than by running a unit test. Three frontier models, each given 1 attempt per instance, repair 24.2%-36.4%, with no pairwise difference significant; difficulty tracks the oracle rather than the domain, at 66.7% on instances graded by process survival against 22.2% on those graded by what the robot did (instance-level p = 0.0027). Because the oracle is constructed rather than inherited we audit it adversarially, and report the decomposition that audit yields: counterfeit patches which suppress a failure without repairing the defect are accepted by the shipped rule 11/11, while a distributional rule over the same data rejects 4 at no cost in false rejects. The residual is an observability bound (what the observation channel discards, no predicate over it can recover), so discrimination must be bought with instrumentation rather than stricter criteria, and our repair rates are bounds: inflated by what the oracle cannot distinguish, deflated by unanimity's rejection of correct fixes under run-to-run noise. We release the corpus, criterion batteries, counterfeit suite and cached telemetry.

摘要（中文）：语言智能体越来越多地用于修改机器人软件，但其能否修复机器人软件尚未得到衡量，因为该领域没有可继承的基准判定标准：机器人缺陷表现为行为异常，而机器人代码库几乎不附带能捕获这些缺陷的测试。我们提出了RoboBugBench基准，包含固定ROS 2导航栈中33个真实且经执行验证的缺陷，在该基准中，候选补丁的评分方式为编译补丁并通过物理仿真驱动机器人运行，而非运行单元测试。三个前沿模型，每实例各尝试一次，修复率为24.2%-36.4%，两两之间无显著差异；难度取决于判定标准而非领域本身，以进程存活为判定的实例修复率为66.7%，而以机器人行为为判定的实例修复率仅为22.2%（实例级p = 0.0027）。由于判定标准是构建而非继承的，我们对其进行了对抗性审计，并报告审计所得的分解结果：伪造补丁（即抑制故障但未真正修复缺陷的补丁）被原有规则全部接受（11/11），而基于相同数据的分布性规则在不产生误拒代价的情况下拒绝了其中4个。剩余问题本质上是可观测性边界（观测通道丢弃的信息，任何基于该通道的谓词均无法恢复），因此区分能力必须通过增加仪器手段而非更严格的评判标准来获得，我们的修复率因此属于有界值：因判定标准无法区分的部分而高估，因全体一致规则在运行间噪声下拒绝正确修复而低估。我们发布了语料库、标准测试集、伪造补丁集及缓存遥测数据。
