Authors: Alexey Tuzikov

Imitation Learning of Avoidance Modes for Efficient Multimodal Model Predictive Control Other

graph neural network model predictive control mode decision control barrier function moving obstacles

简要说明：SideNet-MPC 通过图神经网络模仿多模态模型预测控制的模式决策，将每个控制周期的优化问题从指数级枚举减少至最多两个，同时保持安全保证并接近专家的成功率。

TLDR: SideNet-MPC uses a graph neural network to imitate the mode decisions of multimodal model predictive control, reducing computation from exponential OCP enumeration to at most two optimal control problems per control period while retaining safety guarantees and matching expert success rates.

Abstract: Multimodal model predictive control (MM-MPC) avoids local minima among moving obstacles by solving one optimal control problem (OCP) per combination of avoidance sides, so its computational cost grows exponentially with the number of decision-critical obstacles. We propose SideNet-MPC, which replaces this enumeration with a mode decision learned by imitating MM-MPC as an expert. A graph neural network is trained to predict the expert's minimum-cost mode, one avoidance side per obstacle. Its edges encode, for each obstacle pair, the gap predicted for the moment the vehicle first reaches either obstacle, so a neighbor that blocks a preferred passage can reverse the proposed side. The expert's selection rule compares its minimum-cost mode with the previously executed mode; SideNet-MPC keeps this rule and substitutes the network proposal for the minimum-cost mode. Hence at most two OCPs are solved per control period, and every applied input still comes from an OCP with control barrier function constraints rather than from the network. In $100$ seed-matched closed-loop Monte Carlo runs of mixed traffic, SideNet-MPC reaches $93\%$ of the expert's success rate and needs \SI{18.6}{ms} per control period on a single thread, 48\% less than the expert's \SI{35.5}{ms} on sixteen parallel threads. In a controlled gap sweep, its proposed side reverses in the same gap interval as the expert's, whereas proposers without pairwise edges, trained on the same data, never reverse and all deadlock at the blocked gates of a deterministic scene.

摘要（中文）：摘要：多模态模型预测控制（MM-MPC）通过为每个避障侧组合求解一个最优控制问题（OCP）来避免移动障碍物间的局部最小值，但其计算成本随决策关键障碍物数量呈指数增长。我们提出SideNet-MPC，通过模仿MM-MPC作为专家来学习模式决策，从而替代这种枚举方式。我们训练一个图神经网络来预测专家的最小成本模式，即每个障碍物的一个避障侧。其边编码了车辆首次到达任一障碍物时预测的间隙，针对每对障碍物，因此阻挡优选通道的邻居可以反转所提议的避障侧。专家的选择规则会比较其最小成本模式与先前执行模式；SideNet-MPC保留该规则，并以网络提议替代最小成本模式。因此，每个控制周期最多仅需求解两个最优控制问题，且每个施加的输入仍来自带控制障碍函数约束的最优控制问题，而非直接来自网络。在100次种子匹配的混合交通闭环蒙特卡洛仿真中，SideNet-MPC达到了专家成功率的93%，且单线程下每个控制周期仅需18.6毫秒，比专家在十六个并行线程上的35.5毫秒减少了48%。在受控间隙扫描测试中，其提议的避障侧在与专家相同的间隙区间内发生反转，而在相同数据上训练、不含成对边的提议模型则从未反转，并在确定性场景中被阻挡的门处全部死锁。

Authors: Changyu Lee, Byung-Kwan Lee, Kanghoon Yoon

Extending Wire-Driven Parallel Robots to Multi-Floating-Link Systems with an Inter-Body Wire Manipulation

wire-driven parallel robot multi-floating-link inter-body wire parallel wire actuation rescue robot

简要说明：本文通过引入体间钢丝，将钢丝驱动并联机器人扩展到可同时处理多个浮动连杆的系统，并在真实机器人上演示了抬起并转移人体模型的救援任务。

TLDR: This paper extends wire-driven parallel robots to handle multiple floating links simultaneously by introducing an inter-body wire, demonstrated through a real-robot rescue task of lifting and transferring a mannequin.

Abstract: Parallel wire-driven systems are a framework in which multiple wires are connected to an end effector, and the end effector is driven by the tensions of those wires. Because they can transmit large forces, up to the breaking strength of the wires, over lengths on the order of several tens of meters, they can realize powerful actuation in large workspaces. In recent years, studies have also investigated connecting wires to external environments such as trees and columns and forming parallel wire actuation on site. However, conventional parallel wire-driven systems often assume a single end effector, and because of interference between wires and links in a shared workspace, it has been difficult to handle multiple floating links simultaneously. In this study, we realize multi-floating-link parallel wire actuation by introducing an inter-body wire. In real-robot experiments, the two bodies supported and lifted a mannequin and transferred it onto a stretcher as a rescue motion. This shows that parallel wire actuation can be extended from a single end effector to a multi-floating-link system, and indicates its potential for broader tasks such as the manipulation of large objects and rescue support.

摘要（中文）：并联索驱系统是一种将多根绳索连接至末端执行器，并通过这些绳索的张力驱动末端执行器的框架结构。由于该系统能够传递直至绳索断裂强度的大力量，且作用距离可达数十米量级，因此能够在大型工作空间内实现强力驱动。近年来，已有研究探索将绳索连接至树木、立柱等外部环境，并在现场构建并联索驱系统。然而，传统并联索驱系统通常假设仅有一个末端执行器，且由于绳索与连杆在共享工作空间中的相互干扰，同时处理多个浮动连杆一直较为困难。在本研究中，我们通过引入体间绳索，实现了多浮动连杆的并联索驱驱动。在真实机器人实验中，两个机体支撑并抬升了一个人体模型，并将其转移至担架上，完成了救援动作。这表明并联索驱驱动可从单一末端执行器扩展至多浮动连杆系统，并展示了其在大型物体操控及救援支持等更广泛任务中的应用潜力。

Authors: Shintaro Inoue, Kento Kawaharazuka, Temma Suzuki, Sota Yuzaki, Keita Yoneda, Kei Okada

Jacobian State Augmented Viable Kinematic Safety Filter Manipulation

Safety Filter Control Barrier Function Quadratic Program Viability Kernel Manipulator

简要说明：本文提出了一种基于雅可比矩阵的运动学安全滤波器，通过增广状态变量和嵌套二次规划（QP）公式，提高机器人操作臂控制的可行性并降低计算成本，在2R和6自由度仿真中验证。

TLDR: This paper introduces a Jacobian-based kinematic safety filter with an augmented state variable and nested QP formulation to improve feasibility and reduce computational cost for robot manipulator control, validated in 2R and 6-DoF simulations.

Abstract: Safety Filters (SF) are leveraged to design certifiably safe controllers, which ensures forward invariance on a defined safe set when the filter is feasible. Predictive Safety Filters (PSF) embed these constraints to a closed-loop model-based optimization method to improve constraint satisfaction, and reduce feasibility loss caused by myopic, one-step filtering. Related viability-based methods emphasize approximating a viability kernel which ensures admissible control for all future time, but requires significant computational expense. This work introduces a Jacobian-based kinematic safety filter leveraging an augmented state variable with task-space velocity and filters task-space acceleration to preserve the feasibility of a low-level filter while enforcing joint position and velocity. The proposed method introduces a nested Quadratic Program (QP) formulation, defines a conservative inner approximation of viability envelope and computes a viable planner online. The method is validated in a simplified 2R planar manipulator simulation environment and shows significant improvement compared to a baseline Control Barrier Function Quadratic Program (CBF-QP) based filter. The experiments highlights the improvements in terms of computation time compared to traditional PSF and Reference Governor approach while also showing significant reduction in feasibility violations. Lastly, a simplified demonstration on a simulated 6-DoF manipulator highlights the potential scalability of the method to higher degree-of-freedom setups.

摘要（中文）：安全过滤器（SF）被用于设计可认证的安全控制器，当过滤器可行时，能够确保在定义的安全集上实现前向不变性。预测安全过滤器（PSF）将这些约束嵌入到基于闭环模型的优化方法中，以改善约束满足情况，并减少因短视的一步滤波而导致的可行性损失。相关的基于生存能力的方法侧重于近似生存核，以确保所有未来时刻都存在可接受的控制器，但这需要大量的计算开销。本工作引入了一种基于雅可比矩阵的运动学安全过滤器，利用带有任务空间速度的增强状态变量，并对任务空间加速度进行滤波，在保证关节位置和速度的同时，保持底层过滤器的可行性。所提出的方法采用了嵌套二次规划（QP）的公式，定义了生存包络的保守内近似，并在线计算可行的规划器。该方法在简化的2R平面机械臂仿真环境中进行了验证，与基于控制障碍函数二次规划（CBF-QP）的基线过滤器相比，显示出显著的改进。实验突出了该方法在计算时间上相比传统PSF和参考治理器方法的优势，同时也显著减少了可行性违反情况。最后，在模拟的6自由度机械臂上的简化演示展示了该方法向更高自由度设置扩展的潜力。

Authors: Siddharth Singh, Joshua Vaughan

REFLEX: A Learned On-Board Reflex for Robust Autonomous Collision Recovery of Soft Quadrotors Other

collision recovery quadrotor proprioceptive recurrent policy PPO flight controller

简要说明：REFLEX是一种用于软四旋翼的碰撞恢复飞行模式，完全在飞行控制器上运行，使用在仿真中训练的本体感受循环策略，相比标准自动驾驶仪显著提高了恢复成功率。

TLDR: REFLEX is a collision-recovery flight mode for soft quadrotors that runs entirely on the flight controller using a proprioceptive recurrent policy trained in simulation, achieving significantly higher recovery rates than a stock autopilot.

Abstract: Collision-resilient airframes allow quadrotors to survive impacts, but do not ensure autonomous post-collision recovery. Innovation gating in stock onboard estimators often rejects valid external velocity measurements after high-speed impacts, compromising recovery. We present REFLEX, a collision-recovery flight mode that runs entirely on the flight controller, requiring neither contact sensors nor a companion computer. Its proprioceptive recurrent policy stabilizes the vehicle without position, velocity, heading, or altitude estimates. The translational estimate is reinitialized while REFLEX is active, and a trust gate checks estimator consistency before returning control to the stock autopilot. The policy is trained in simulation using proximal policy optimization, with episodes initialized from post-impact states measured in 47 real collisions. In hardware experiments, REFLEX recovered 19 of 22 wall impacts at 5.03 $\pm$ 0.09 m/s, compared with 1 of 14 for the matched stock autopilot. These included 15 consecutive recoveries in a single flight. A separate exploratory flight demonstrated two additional recoveries at 6.02 and 6.05 m/s within the same flight, exceeding the previously reported velocity for autonomous wall-collision recovery by 64%.

摘要（中文）：抗碰撞机身使四旋翼飞行器能够承受撞击，但并不能确保碰撞后的自主恢复。库存机载估计器中的创新门控往往会在高速撞击后拒绝有效的外部速度测量值，从而影响恢复能力。我们提出了REFLEX，一种完全在飞行控制器上运行的碰撞恢复飞行模式，既不需要接触传感器，也不需要伴随计算机。其本体感觉循环策略在不需要位置、速度、航向或高度估计的情况下稳定飞行器。当REFLEX激活时，平移估计被重新初始化，并且在将控制权交还给库存自动驾驶仪之前，信任门控会检查估计器的一致性。该策略使用近端策略优化在仿真中训练，训练情节从47次真实碰撞中测得的碰撞后状态初始化。在硬件实验中，REFLEX在5.03±0.09 m/s的速度下成功恢复了22次墙壁碰撞中的19次，而匹配的库存自动驾驶仪仅恢复了14次中的1次。这其中包括单次飞行中连续15次成功恢复。另一次探索性飞行展示了在同一飞行中额外两次以6.02和6.05 m/s速度进行的恢复，比此前报道的自主墙壁碰撞恢复速度高出64%。

Authors: Jakob Hermeler, Luca Girardi, Gabriel Maquignaz, Stefan Leutenegger, Stefano Mintchev

Esports World Model Dataset WorldModel

world model dataset multiplayer games replay-clock alignment partial observability game state

简要说明：本文介绍了电子竞技世界模型数据集（EWM），这是一个来自星际争霸II、Dota 2和反恐精英2的大规模人类游戏数据集，包含同步的渲染视频、游戏原生动作、结构化状态和事件，以支持多人联合控制的世界模型和交互环境的研究。

TLDR: This paper introduces the Esports World Model Dataset (EWM), a large-scale collection of human gameplay from StarCraft II, Dota 2, and Counter-Strike 2, with synchronized rendered video, game-native actions, structured state, and events to support research on jointly controlled multiplayer world models and interactive environments.

Abstract: Interactive world models must capture how multiple participants jointly change a shared environment while observing different parts of it. Competitive games make this challenge concrete: players cooperate and compete, while fog of war, team vision and camera placement determine what each can see. Modeling these interactions requires data that connect individual observations and actions to shared state and events. We introduce the Esports World Model Dataset (EWM), a collection of human gameplay spanning StarCraft II, Dota 2 and Counter-Strike 2, with 3,053 games and maps and approximately 4,880 player-view hours, including estimated hours for the ongoing CS2 extension. It includes 4,628 completed StarCraft II views, all ten perspectives for 303 Dota 2 matches, and up to ten views per round in CS2. Across these views, replay-clock alignment connects rendered video with game-native actions, structured state and events from the same match. The three games expose complementary observation conditions: private fog of war, shared team vision and first-person viewpoints. In StarCraft II, player-specific entity records further distinguish live observations from remembered snapshots and link co-observed entities across opposing views. Together with temporal alignment, these records allow researchers to distinguish legitimate information differences from disagreement about shared state. By connecting human decisions, shared dynamics and player-specific information, EWM supports research toward jointly controlled multiplayer world models and interactive environments populated by teammates and opponents learned from human play.

摘要（中文）：交互式世界模型必须捕捉多个参与者在共享环境中如何协同改变环境，同时各自观察环境的不同部分。竞技类游戏使这一挑战变得具体：玩家既合作又竞争，而战争迷雾、队伍视野和摄像机位置决定了各自能看到的内容。对这些交互进行建模，需要将个体观察和行动与共享状态及事件联系起来的数据。我们推出了电子竞技世界模型数据集（EWM），该数据集涵盖了《星际争霸II》、《Dota 2》和《反恐精英2》的人类对局数据，包含3,053场对局和地图，以及约4,880小时的玩家视角录像（包括正在扩展的CS2部分的预估时长）。数据集包含4,628个完整的《星际争霸II》视角、303场《Dota 2》比赛的十个视角，以及CS2中每回合最多十个视角。在这些视角中，回放时钟对齐将渲染视频与游戏原生的动作、结构化状态及同一场比赛的事件相连接。这三款游戏呈现出互补的观察条件：私有的战争迷雾、共享的队伍视野和第一人称视角。在《星际争霸II》中，针对玩家的实体记录进一步区分了实时观察与记忆快照，并将对立方视角中共同观察到的实体关联起来。结合时间对齐，这些记录使研究者能够区分合法的信息差异与对共享状态的认知分歧。通过连接人类决策、共享动态和玩家特定信息，EWM为研究联合控制的多玩家世界模型及由人类对局学习到的队友和对手所构成的交互环境提供了支持。

Authors: Weiyu Ma, Zeyuan Gong, Xuhui Liu, Wenxuan Zhang, Jian Ding, Xinyu Cui, Jian Zhao, Mohamed Elhoseiny

Mobility Helps Learning: Unsupervised Model Adaptation for Object Recognition via Movement AutonomousDriving

test-time adaptation pseudo-label filtering object recognition autonomous driving embodied agents

简要说明：MoCaFe 通过利用智能体移动过程中预测方差的变化，实现无标签环境下的模型自适应，采用移动校准的伪标签过滤和难样本选择，可选的 p-MoCaFe 扩展提供有界偏差的损失估计。

TLDR: MoCaFe adapts pre-trained object recognition models to new environments without labels by exploiting prediction variance from an agent's movement, using mobility-calibrated pseudo-label filtering and hard-sample selection, with an optional p-MoCaFe extension for bias-bounded loss estimation.

Abstract: Movable agents, such as autonomous vehicles and robots, should be able to autonomously adapt their pre-trained object recognition models to new environments without human annotations. While existing test-time adaptation (TTA) methods address label-free model adaptation, they typically treat test data as independent snapshots, without constructively exploiting a rich, unique source of supervision: the significant variance in prediction quality as an agent observes the same object from different distances and viewpoints. To capitalize on this, we propose \texttt{MoCaFe}, a model-agnostic and hyperparameter-insensitive paradigm that leverages motion-induced prediction variance for unsupervised adaptation. Specifically, we first develop mobility-calibrated filtering of pseudo-labels, which constructs reliable pseudo-labels by fusing cross-view predictions using inverse-variance weights. The filtered pseudo-labels then guide the selection of ``hard samples'' for effective learning. To further suppress pseudo-label corruption, we introduce \texttt{p-MoCaFe}, an optional extension that uses a public dataset to assign weighting factors to data samples, yielding an estimator of the clean loss with bounded bias. Extensive experiments on autonomous driving (nuScenes, KITTI) and embodied-agent datasets show that \texttt{MoCaFe} significantly outperforms state-of-the-art TTA schemes, achieving up to approximately 20% accuracy gain.

摘要（中文）：移动智能体（如自动驾驶车辆和机器人）应能够自主地将其预训练的目标识别模型适应到新环境中，而无需人工标注。尽管现有的测试时自适应（TTA）方法能够解决无标签模型适应问题，但它们通常将测试数据视为独立的快照，未能建设性地利用一个丰富且独特的监督来源：即智能体从不同距离和视角观察同一物体时预测质量的显著差异。为充分利用这一点，我们提出了一种与模型无关且对超参数不敏感的范式——\texttt{MoCaFe}，利用运动引起的预测方差进行无监督适应。具体而言，我们首先开发了基于移动性校准的伪标签过滤方法，通过使用逆方差权重融合跨视角预测来构建可靠的伪标签。过滤后的伪标签进而指导“困难样本”的选择以实现高效学习。为进一步抑制伪标签污染，我们引入了\texttt{p-MoCaFe}，这是一种可选扩展，利用公共数据集为数据样本赋予权重因子，从而得到偏差有界的干净损失估计器。在自动驾驶（nuScenes、KITTI）及具身智能体数据集上的大量实验表明，\texttt{MoCaFe}显著优于最先进的TTA方案，准确率提升最高可达约20%。
